title: Multigres Deployment Engineer
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for an engineer to own the deployment and operational infrastructure of Multigres, our distributed Postgres platform. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the Multigres Operator, ensuring reliable cloud deployments, and creating the tooling that powers our Kubernetes-based infrastructure. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Build and maintain the Multigres Operator - Maintain our Go-based Kubernetes operator that orchestrates distributed Postgres deployments - Architect cloud deployment infrastructure - Design and implement robust deployment patterns for EKS and other Kubernetes platforms - Manage storage and networking layers - Work with CSI drivers, persistent volumes, and cross-cloud networking to ensure data reliability and connectivity - Develop deployment tooling - Create internal tools and automation for provisioning, scaling, and managing Multigres clusters - Ensure operational excellence - Build monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities into the deployment layer - Collaborate across teams - Work with database engineers, SRE, and product teams to deliver seamless deployment experiences YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE: - Strong systems programming skills - Proficiency in Go and experience building production-grade operators or controllers - Deep Kubernetes expertise - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, custom resources, and cloud-managed Kubernetes services (EKS, GKE, AKS) - Database operations knowledge - Understanding of database deployment patterns, backup/restore, replication, and high availability - Distributed systems experience - Familiarity with consensus protocols, failure scenarios, and designing for resilience - Cloud infrastructure background - Experience with cloud-native deployment tooling, IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), and cloud provider APIs - Production operations mindset - Track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with CSI storage drivers and storage orchestration in Kubernetes - Knowledge of cross-cloud networking tools like Cilium, Istio, or similar service mesh technologies - Prior work with sharded query serving systems like Vitess - Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: People Safety & Resilience Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong><strong class="textBold">An overview of this role</strong></strong></h3> <p>As a People Safety & Resilience Manager at GitLab, you'll help protect team members working from home, in Labs, and in coworking spaces. You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.</p> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.</li> <li value="2">Identify and meet each country's legal safety obligations with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, and local vendors. Track changes in the law and keep records of required appointments, assessments, committees, training, and medical surveillance. Manage vendor agreements and keep safety and resilience services within budget.</li> <li value="3">Coordinate required consultation with works councils and team members before GitLab makes a decision or contacts affected team members outside the consultation process. Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.</li> <li value="4">Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.</li> <li value="6">Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.</li> <li value="7">Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.</li> <li value="8">Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h3> <ul> <li value="1">Experience delivering safety and resilience programs across several countries, covering occupational health and safety plus either crisis management or business continuity.</li> <li value="2">Knowledge of when to consult team members or works councils, hold hearings, or make decisions jointly, and how to document each step. To handle GitLab's legal obligations in Germany, you'll need direct experience applying the Betriebsverfassungsgesetz and Arbeitssicherheitsgesetz.</li> <li value="3">Ability to apply ISO 45001, ISO 22361, ISO 22301, the ANSI/ASIS workplace violence prevention standard, and the European Union framework directive on safety and health at work when drafting policies and procedures with legal and compliance partners and external advisers.</li> <li value="4">Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.</li> <li value="5">Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.</li> <li value="6">Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.</li> <li value="7">Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.</li> <li value="8">Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Safety or business continuity credentials, ISO 45001 or ISO 22301 lead implementer or auditor qualifications, and works council or labor relations training are also helpful.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></h3> <p>We work with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, the crisis management team, team member representatives, and external partners. You'll bring these partners together through plans with named owners and deadlines. Our People Safety & Security scorecard tracks how well we meet safety standards and legal duties and which consultations, exercises, and incident reviews we've completed. It also tracks whether we've reviewed continuity plans in the past twelve months and closed audit findings by their deadlines.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$115,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$194,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Executive Assistant, Product and Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Executive Assistant at GitLab, you’ll help two senior leaders protect time for their priorities. You’ll primarily support a Vice President in Product and also support a Vice President in Marketing. You’ll manage both executives’ calendars, travel, and expenses.</p> <p>This all-remote role is open to candidates in the United States and Canada, with no preference for a specific time zone within those countries.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Manage both executives’ calendars across time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts before they disrupt priority meetings.</li> <li>Prepare a complete itinerary for each domestic or international trip, including flights, hotels, and any required visas.</li> <li>Submit and reconcile expense reports for both executives by each reporting deadline, following GitLab’s travel and expense policies.</li> <li>Coordinate recurring leadership activities with the Senior Executive Business Partner and keep shared office resources, distribution lists, Slack channels, and calendars up to date.</li> <li>Plan team events, offsites, and large meetings with partners across GitLab so schedules and logistics are in place before each event.</li> <li>Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools like Claude to capture meeting notes and reduce manual note-taking while protecting confidential information.</li> <li>Cover for other Executive Business Administrators by handling time-sensitive calendar, travel, and expense requests before they’re due.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience providing executive-level administrative support to multiple senior leaders at once and adapting to each leader’s needs.</li> <li>Proficiency with productivity, video meeting, team messaging, and travel and expense tools, and the ability to learn new tools quickly. We use Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and Navan. Experience with comparable tools, such as Microsoft Teams for messaging, is welcome.</li> <li>Sound judgment under pressure: you can work independently, stay composed when plans change, and know when to reprioritize or escalate competing executive requests.</li> <li>Experience planning offsites or comparable events, with the organization, clear communication, and attention to detail to coordinate with multiple teams.</li> <li>Experience using AI to improve day-to-day operations while keeping sensitive information confidential.</li> <li>Ability to build relationships and gather context remotely, with flexibility in your working hours to coordinate across regions. Experience supporting teams across offices or regions can transfer to this role.</li> <li>Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally to support executives, offsites, and key events. Expect roughly one trip per quarter on average, though frequency will vary.</li> <li>Experience supporting Product or Design leaders, or working at a software company or startup, is helpful but not required.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and value transferable experience.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Executive Business Administration team helps GitLab’s leaders work effectively in an asynchronous environment. We work with teams across GitLab to coordinate leadership meetings, maintain shared resources, and bring people together for events. You’ll partner with our Senior Executive Business Partner and other Executive Business Administrators.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. title: Financial Crime Lead
description: What is Finary? Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real. Why now? AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested. What we offer We’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here . The opportunity More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination. Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto. What you'll do Lead the AML/CFT framework: procedures, client risk classification, detection rules and tools (screening, blockchain analytics, Travel Rule), calibrated on our own data. Investigate and decide the hard cases: enhanced reviews of individuals and companies (ownership chains, financial statements, flows), on-chain investigations, decisions on suspicion. Draft and file suspicious transaction reports, and act as deputy TRACFIN declarant and correspondent. Handle screening and asset freezing: PEP, sanctions and adverse media hits, list updates. Build with AI: design and tune the agents and rules in our back-office tool that prepare files and clear first-level reviews, and keep the decision on suspicion human. Work with Ops, Care, Product and our outsourced review team so that AML decisions are clear, fast and fair to the honest majority of our clients. What we're looking for You've spent 6 to 8 years in AML/CFT in financial services, including hands-on work at a crypto-asset service provider (PSAN/CASP). You've drafted and filed suspicious transaction reports with TRACFIN yourself. You investigate on-chain: you use blockchain analytics tools and you know the Travel Rule and self-hosted wallets. You hold a certification in on-chain analysis (Chainalysis CCI, CCCA or CRC, or a TRM Labs or Elliptic equivalent) and a Travel Rule certification (Notabene NB-TRFC or equivalent). You work with data and AI every day: you query data yourself and you already use AI in your reviews or investigations. This is a must, not a plus. You decide on evidence, you keep weak signals in proportion, and you explain your decisions clearly. You prioritise a growing queue by risk without missing a legal deadline, and you move the framework forward at the same time. Fluent French and professional English. This role is not for you if you'd rather stay on onboarding checks, you prefer advising to deciding, or you need a large financial crime department and mature tools before you can start. You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: investigating cases, deciding them and filing the reports. Interviews Interviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. As an international company, we expect a working level of English, which we test during the screening call. Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity • €65K – €80K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus) You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology. Why join us? 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development. 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations. 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites. 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. About us – in brief Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%. Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide. Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. Your Role – What You'll Own You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform. Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation. Your Responsibilities Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites. Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need. Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites. Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs. Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues. Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities. Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned. What You Bring We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations. Must-have – Essential Requirements The following skills and experience are essential for this position: Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage. Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure. Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management. Infrastructure Modernization A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems. Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations. Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments. Identity & Access Management Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments. Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls. Endpoint Management Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment. Resilience, Security & Monitoring Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor. Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation. Communication & Collaboration Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations. Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations. Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered. Nice-to-have – Additional Experience The following skills are beneficial but not essential: Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects. Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods. Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management. Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers. Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel. Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub. Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform. Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP. Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300. Your First 12 Months Your initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure: Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure. Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt. Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required. Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune. Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency. Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery. Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. What We Offer Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site. Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience. Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses. Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security. Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices. Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group. 📍 Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus) 📅 Start date: As soon as possible ⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-time Ready to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure? We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements. Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team. We look forward to hearing from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Postgres Tooling to join our CLI team and help build the open-source tools developers use to change their Postgres schemas safely. You’ll join as a co-maintainer of pg-delta, our schema diff and migration engine, and grow into leading it. Given two databases, or a database and a folder of SQL files describing the schema you want, pg-delta works out the differences and generates the migration to get from one to the other. It powers supabase db diff, db pull, and declarative schemas, and it runs underneath Supabase’s platform, branching, and AI agent workflows. Every migration it generates is verified on a throwaway clone before it’s trusted, and it’s tested against 331 scenarios on PostgreSQL 14–18. We’re now working toward a stable, standalone 1.0 release for any Postgres developer, on Supabase or not. This is a correctness-first role. The SQL this tool generates runs against production databases, so privilege safety and avoiding data loss are non-negotiable. It’s a great fit for someone who loves Postgres at the catalog level, enjoys compiler-style problems, and thrives in async, fast-paced environments. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Co-maintain pg-delta: review and merge changes, including PRs written by AI agents, and grow into its lead maintainer. - Own correctness: triage bug reports from GitHub and support, fix diff and dependency-ordering bugs, and extend test coverage across Postgres versions. - Make sure generated migrations are privilege-safe and never silently lose data, by detecting destructive changes and rewriting them into safe equivalents where possible. - Help take pg-delta to a stable 1.0: a public API with a semver contract, documentation, and broader coverage of Postgres extensions. - Work with the open-source community: triage issues, review outside contributions, and say no gracefully when a request doesn’t fit. - Work with the teams across Supabase that build on pg-delta, so migrations are generated and run the same way everywhere. - Write the design docs and technical strategy that set the tool’s direction, working async across teams. - Share the CLI team’s on-call rotation. Weekdays are covered follow-the-sun, and because we ship packaged software that users can roll back, pages are rare. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU Must have: - Have 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, including deep, hands-on work with PostgreSQL. - Know Postgres internals at the catalog level: pg_catalog, pg_depend, object ownership, grants and default privileges, RLS policies, and extension membership. - Understand DDL and migration semantics: which changes take locks, which can’t run inside a transaction, how dependencies determine ordering, and how to spot a destructive change. - Treat a migration that silently loosens access as a top-severity bug. - Write strong TypeScript, and design tests for correctness, such as differential, property-based, or corpus testing across multiple Postgres versions. - Are comfortable with compiler-style problems: dependency graphs, topological ordering, cycle handling, and diffing. - Can confidently review complex changes in an intricate codebase, including AI-generated PRs. - Have owned software in production with users in the loop: staged rollouts, error monitoring, and triaging real bug reports. - Have led a technical project across several teams, from an ambiguous start to production. - Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. Nice to have, roughly in order of how much they’d help: - Have built or maintained schema diff or migration tooling (such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, or Flyway/Liquibase), or worked with pg_dump internals. - Open-source maintainer experience: API contracts, semver, documentation, and community triage. - Familiarity with Postgres extensions such as pg_cron, pgmq, pg_partman, vault, pg_net, pgvector, or PostGIS. - Experience with Go. - Contributions to Postgres itself, or authorship of a Postgres extension. - Experience with Supabase or another managed Postgres platform. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale. This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume. - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping. - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage. - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on. - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load. - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles. - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter. - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck. - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Technical Pre - Sales Engineer
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions. Your mission As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team. Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next. What you will do Qualify – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit. Run requirement workshops – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria. Check feasibility – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed. Drive the concept – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place. Be the technical face to the customer – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs. Close the loop – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build. What you bring 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components) You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home. Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. title: Network Architect, Backbone Network
description: Design and build the global network that connects Radiant’s data centres, customers and future regions. At a glance Team: Infrastructure Delivery, Office of the CTO Reports to: Infrastructure Delivery lead Location: UK based, with travel to sites and industry events Work model: Hybrid Who we are Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale, powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. Our Infrastructure Delivery team designs and builds the systems that connect our sites and bring new capacity online. The backbone is a critical part of that work as Radiant expands across regions. The opportunity You will own the architecture of Radiant’s global backbone, from the first design decision through build, testing and handover. It will connect our data centres, new developments, cloud and customer interconnects, while meeting demanding requirements for resilience, capacity and data sovereignty. You will be the design authority for the backbone, working hands-on with a small architecture team, delivery partners, vendors and carriers. Infrastructure Operations will run the network after go-live, so you will bring them into decisions early and give them a network they can operate confidently. What you’ll do Define the backbone architecture and roadmap, including routing, traffic engineering, site connectivity, transit, peering and private interconnects. Turn customer, capacity and sovereignty requirements into designs that can be built and operated. Work with cluster network, infrastructure, storage, security and data centre teams to resolve trade-offs. Produce high-level and low-level designs, bills of materials, test plans and acceptance criteria. Lead design reviews and approve the technical design before build and handover. Evaluate routing and optical platforms, carriers and proposed designs. Contribute technical requirements and assessments to procurement processes while Procurement owns commercial terms. Establish standards for network automation, a source of truth and streaming telemetry. Validate designs in the lab, investigate complex backbone faults and improve the architecture as the network grows. Represent Radiant in technical discussions with customers, vendors and the wider network community, including at relevant industry events. What you’ll bring You have owned a multi-site backbone from design through production, including delivery across more than one country. You bring around ten years in network engineering, with substantial carrier, service provider or hyperscale backbone experience. You have deep practical knowledge of BGP, an interior routing protocol such as IS-IS or OSPF, MPLS and segment routing. You can design internet edges, peering, data centre interconnects and resilient paths. You understand optical transport, including DWDM, coherent optics, dark fibre and wavelength services, and can make sound decisions across leased and owned capacity. You have configured and tested major routing platforms, automated network changes with tools such as Python or Ansible, and worked with a network source of truth. You can write clear designs and defend them with engineers, executives and customers. You hold a current expert-level network certification, such as JNCIE-SP or CCIE Service Provider, or an equivalent, and are comfortable travelling to sites and speaking at industry events. Nice to have: Experience with GPU or AI infrastructure networks, sovereign or regulated environments, long-haul fibre routes, or contributions to the wider network community. Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, and we’d rather hear from you than miss out. What we offer Our UK package includes share options, a bonus scheme, 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays, a 5% employer pension contribution, private medical cover, dental and optical support, wellbeing benefits, paid parental leave, dedicated learning time and a cycle to work scheme. Confirm the applicable package with People before posting. Equal opportunities Radiant is an equal opportunity employer. title: HPC Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer
description: About Us We’re a fast-growing GPU-as-a-Service provider, delivering scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure purpose-built for AI and HPC workloads. Operating across global data centres, we run mission-critical environments where uptime, throughput, and ultra-low latency are non-negotiable. Role Overview We are looking for a senior Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer with deep experience operating large-scale distributed systems and recent hands-on expertise in high-performance computing (HPC) and AI infrastructure. This is an operations-first SRE role, working in a 24/7/365 on-call environment, responsible for ensuring reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical infrastructure. This role sits within a cross-functional organisation spanning network engineering, infrastructure SRE, Platform SRE, infrastructure tooling engineers (software) and data centre operations. The ideal candidate has progressed through large-scale, globally distributed or multi-site infrastructure environments and has more recently specialised in GPU-accelerated HPC systems. This role provides exposure to the latest high-density AI compute platforms , including next-generation GPU infrastructure at significant scale. You will bring strong breadth across bare metal, networking, storage, virtualisation, and orchestration, alongside deep HPC experience including NVIDIA GPU ecosystems, RDMA networking (RoCE and InfiniBand), and performance validation and benchmarking. Strong Linux and distributed systems expertise is essential. Alongside operational ownership, this is a deeply technical Infrastructure SRE role centred on advanced operational troubleshooting and performance evaluation across large-scale HPC systems. You will investigate complex, cross-layer issues spanning GPU compute, networking, storage, and orchestration, building a clear understanding of system behaviour under real production AI and HPC workloads. A key responsibility is performance evaluation, testing, and operational acceptance of new HPC environments, ensuring platforms meet defined reliability, scalability, and performance expectations before entering production. You will work across hardware, network, and software layers to validate readiness of high-density GPU infrastructure and support safe, predictable deployment at scale. title: Manager, Training and Enablement
description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. You will own the knowledge, content and learning programs, run an efficient AI-assisted operating model with expert human oversight, and act as the main liaison between Training & Enablement and our cross-functional partners. Reporting to the SVP of Customer Success, this is a hands-on leadership role with room to shape functional strategy and grow your impact as the team scales. Our Training & Enablement Team: We are a fully remote, multilingual group of trainers, writers, localization specialists and hospitality veterans who turn a fast-moving product into knowledge people can use. We build with a test-and-learn mindset and use AI to strip out drafting and lookup work, so people can focus on teaching, judgment and quality. Our principle: standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. What You Bring to the Team: • Lead, coach and develop the team across knowledge, delivery and operations, managing hiring, capacity planning and the metrics that justify headcount, while keeping workloads sustainable as release volume grows. • Establish the operating model: an intake and review framework with a published scope charter that defines functional ownership, and build team AI proficiency through continuous learning and tooling investments. • Run a content engine that turns product updates into role-based knowledge assets, holding quality standards for brand voice, documentation structure, terminology and courseware. • Manage knowledge base architecture and tagging for AI retrieval, categorize workflows by automation level so human oversight goes to high-judgment work, and set localization policies that pair AI-assisted translation with human review. • Design modular, role-based learning programs (reserving live training for interactive problem-solving), including onboarding and enablement for internal teams and customers from unified content, plus badging and certification frameworks, grounded in practical hospitality context and product workflows. • Manage live delivery schedules, global time-zone coverage, contractors, and the enablement platforms, vendors and content tools. • Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Ops to define clear accountabilities, ensure releases meet customer readiness and learning standards before launch, bring customer feedback (support queries, AI gaps, community insights) into product needs, and track performance data to refine programs and show business value. What Sets You Up for Success: • Hospitality experience, meeting one of: 2+ years at group level (for example a large hotel management company or global brand); 5+ years at senior hotel management level in a large hotel or resort; or 5+ years in an area or regional role for a smaller chain, brand, ownership or management group. Experience limited to OTAs, GDS or travel distribution does not meet this requirement. • 5+ years in training, enablement, learning and development, knowledge management or customer education, ideally in SaaS or hospitality technology. • 2+ years leading a team, including specialists across several countries and time zones. • A record of designing and running learning or content programs at scale with measured outcomes (such as time to competence, ticket deflection or content accuracy), and the analytical habits to turn throughput, survey and support data into priorities and a business case. • Hands-on use of AI to produce and review content or training, with sound judgment about where AI must not replace human review, and experience with a learning management system (such as Docebo) and knowledge or content tools, or the ability to learn them quickly. • Skill at setting scope and saying no clearly to partners across Product, Support, Sales and Operations, without relying on authority. • Strong writing and clear spoken communication with a global audience, fluent English, and a self-directed, calm approach when priorities shift. A “mop bucket” attitude: some days you are the planner, the trainer, and the editor in the same afternoon. Bonus Skills to Stand Out: • Experience at a hospitality SaaS or PMS company, or in hotel training • Instructional design or adult-learning qualification, or experience building certification, badging, customer education or community programs • Portuguese, Spanish, or Thai; familiarity with Salesforce, Zendesk, Guru, ClickUp, Crowdin, and video production tools Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $110,000 and $135,000 USD. title: Events Lead - Brazil and Latam
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. title: Compensation Manager
description: Our Mission: 6sense 's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. About the Role: Are you a compensation leader who loves turning market data into smart, fair pay decisions? 6sense's Total Rewards team is looking for a Compensation Manager to design, govern and evolve our global compensation programs, so our pay and equity practices stay competitive, compliant and aligned with our business goals. You will own core compensation programs and cycles, strengthen job architecture and governance, and use technology, analytics, and AI to make compensation work faster, more consistent, and more actionable. What You’ll Do: Lead the design, implementation, and governance of 6sense's global compensation programs, policies, philosophy and operating standards in partnership, with the Senior Director, Total Rewards Own global salary and equity structures, job architecture, leveling, job codes, and title governance, using market data and internal equity to maintain competitive and consistent frameworks. Set the compensation and benchmarking, including vendor participation, market-pricing methodology, and regular refreshes of salary and equity bands. Lead and execute the annual and mid-year salary review programs, including salary budget planning, merit guidelines and approvals Build the equity grant budget and model scenarios for compensation strategy proposals Analyze compensation cycle outcomes against philosophy and budget, and present findings and recommendations to leadership Maintenance and day-to-day administration of our equity programs and equity reporting tools Advise People Business Partners, Recruiting, FP&A and business leaders on benchmarks and offers for senior and strategic hires, and handle escalations and exceptions Translate compensation data into clear recommendations, executive dashboards, and quarterly reporting that enable timely, consistent decisions. Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable federal, state, and international requirements, and establish controls that support audit readiness and responsible governance. Establish compensation governance standards and evaluate program effectiveness to identify areas for improvement Manage compensation vendor relationships, oversee contract timelines and evaluate tool effectiveness ahead of renewals Define requirements and data standards for our compensation planning tools (Workday, Pave and Radford), and approve configuration changes Apply strong AI fluency to redesign compensation workflows, improve analysis and data quality, accelerate scenario modeling and communications, and introduce responsible automation with appropriate human judgment, privacy, and controls. Propose and create training for employees and managers around our compensation and leveling needs. What You’ll Bring (Required): 8+ years of experience in compensation, including ownership of equity and sales compensation Demonstrated experience leading compensation cycles, market pricing, job architecture, leveling, pay structures, equity modeling, and executive-ready analysis. International compensation experience, with working knowledge of compensation practices and regulations across multiple countries Hands-on experience with Workday and compensation tools such as Pave and Radford, along with advanced spreadsheet and data-analysis skills. Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, dynamic sheets) Strong AI fluency: the ability to select and use AI tools effectively, validate outputs, protect sensitive employee data, and translate AI capabilities into responsible, scalable compensation workflows. Excellent analytical judgment and communication skills, with the ability to turn complex data into a clear point of view and influence senior stakeholders. A strategic and solutions-oriented mindset, paired with the willingness to stay close to execution, move with urgency, and bring forward practical recommendations. Success in the First 12 Months: Improve overall data quality, reporting consistency, and system governance for compensation, equity, leveling, and salary bands. Modernize executive workforce reporting and self-service analytics capabilities. Streamline and automate key Compensation processes to improve efficiency and our business partnership. Introduce practical AI-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness of the Compensation function. Build a scalable foundation for future growth through technology, analytics, and operational excellence. Review our current compensation training to evaluate effectiveness and propose improvements. Improve dashboard reporting and the UI so compensation information is easily digested and actionable Base Salary Range: $109,200.00 - $160,160.00. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. title: Founding Product Engineer - Listen Labs
description: Listen Labs Everyone hates surveys. They’re tedious to fill out and give shallow data. That’s because they’re only a proxy for the real thing: conversations . Through a conversation, you can ask follow-up questions and get deep insights in a way that’s fun for the interviewee. Except you can’t have 1:1 conversations with everyone… Listen Labs has built an AI interviewer that can ask follow-up questions, like a conversation, but at the scale and ease of use of a survey. Technical Challenges Turn qualitative data into quantitative insights Listen Labs clusters free-form conversation into a structured format. This is not a trivial task. We use embeddings, fine-tuned large language models, and more to solve these problems. Ask the right questions Having a great conversation is not trivial. We’re fine-tuning and prompting in novel ways to get the right output from LLMs. Multi-modality We’ve built the fastest speech-to-speech pipeline but there’s a number of challenges we need to address to make it better. Our interviewer has audio input and output to the LLM and that’s tricky to get right. Investors There’s been $30B+ of market cap created from bringing surveys online. Our partner at Sequoia, [Bryan Schreier]( https://www.sequoiacap.com/people/bryan-schreier/ ), was the first investor in Qualtrics – the $12B survey company. About you You love working on products end-to-end without detailed direction You want to work in Next.js, TypeScript, and large language models You are a collaborative builder and like to build systems with other engineers in mind. You are an excellent written and verbal communicator. You know when to seek assistance, and it's typically to discuss tradeoffs. You don't scoff at unglamorous engineering tasks, yaks don't shave themselves. Highly technical Interested in building products end-to-end and owning the user experience Excited about large language models What we offer $150,000 - $200,000 USD in cash. High equity grant even for an early stage startup. Work in person in our office @ 425 2nd St in San Francisco.

description: Who We Are: AcuTech Group, Inc. is a premier provider of process safety, risk management, chemical security, industrial fire protection engineering, and emergency management services. title: Studentische Hilfskraft / Werkstudent Projektentwicklung (m/w/d)

title: Renewals Manager - Italy/ Spain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div> </div> <div> <h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>Reports to: Manager, Renewals</p> <p>This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure. </li> <li>Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next.</li> <li>Identify and surface expansion opportunities — additional seats, tiers, or modules — that come out of those conversations.</li> <li>Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.</li> <li>Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or
