<li>Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving.</li> <li>Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.</li> <li>Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.</li> <li>Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results.</li> <li>Contribute to team goals by working collaboratively with peer RM’s.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Can execute basic renewal processes independently ("basic knots") and has been introduced to more advanced scenarios ("complex knots") such as multi-year deals, upsell-attached renewals, or non-standard terms.</li> <li>Developing understanding of GitLab's way of working, values, and high-performance culture.</li> <li>Awareness of GitLab's remote work best practices.</li> <li>Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.</li> <li><span class="s1">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.</p> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: General Counsel (remote)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel </strong>to<strong> </strong>lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical’s legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment where the questions are often genuinely unprecedented — the terms on which Ubuntu is distributed, copyleft at enterprise scale, and commercial models built with the world’s largest cloud and silicon providers. The role calls for breadth across commercial contracting, corporate governance, IP and compliance rather than depth in any one of them. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>At least five years of senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business — a company whose product is software or technology it licenses to others, rather than technology-related work inside a company that buys and integrates it.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team of 15-20 or more qualified lawyers, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Direct experience of public company governance — listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls — gained either as counsel inside a listed company or on a listing process.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO from preparation to admission.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Chemicals Supplier Engagement Specialist
description: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly. Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a Chemicals Supplier Engagement Specialist to lead the engagement with specialty chemical and raw material suppliers and to deliver exceptional outcomes for the buyers on Valdera’s procurement platform. Suppliers play a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect high-quality quotes. Delivering that quality depends on identifying the right suppliers—and on our ability to motivate their active participation on Valdera’s procurement platform. This requires a strong understanding of chemical markets and a proactive approach towards supplier outreach. You will take ownership of supplier engagement, including the simultaneous management of multiple buyer-initiated Requests for Quotes (RFQs). You’re energized by applying your expertise in chemicals, conducting in-depth supply market assessments, and confidently engaging with suppliers across the globe. As a customer-obsessed professional, you are dedicated to delivering exceptional outcomes for our buyers. Role Responsibilities: Own and manage a high volume of Request for Quotes (RFQs) for buyers, ensuring timely delivery of multiple high-quality quotes for each requested material Assess supplier landscape to identify and select appropriate suppliers for requested materials Engage with new suppliers to confirm material availability and secure competitive quotes Facilitate communication between suppliers and buyers regarding product specifications, samples and delivery terms Validate the quality and accuracy of quotes and supplier-submitted data Build and maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers already active on the Valdera platform Onboard new suppliers onto the Valdera platform ensuring a smooth and frictionless integration experience Maintain thorough documentation of product availability, supplier communication and sourcing activity Experience & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in the chemical industry Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or natural science 5+ years of experience in sourcing, technical sales, business development, partnership, or management consulting Demonstrated ability to conduct supply market assessments and identify suppliers for specific chemicals / raw materials Extensive knowledge of chemicals / raw materials and relevant technical expertise in reviewing RFQs (TDS, SDS, COA, etc.). Ability to identify alternate or offset materials by reviewing technical documentation and product chemistry. Experience in establishing and managing strong supplier relationships Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build trust and rapport with suppliers Capable of creating structured plans, tracking steps, and managing multiple priorities effectively Compensation Additional Information Salary Range: Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role. Benefits: Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera. Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

title: Embedded Software Leader
description: Who We Are Inspiren offers a complete and connected technology ecosystem for senior living. Founded by Michael Wang, a former Green Beret and cardiothoracic nurse, Inspiren was built on the belief that compassionate care and technology can and should coexist. Our integrated solutions fit into existing workflows and give senior-living operators greater visibility into what is happening across their communities. Supported by nurse specialists and powerful analytics, Inspiren helps teams make informed clinical and operational decisions that improve efficiency, outcomes, and quality of care. You’ll join a growing global team united by a shared mission, with a new NYC office designed to strengthen collaboration and in-person connection. About the Role We are seeking an Embedded Software Leader that will own everything from the OS up on every device we ship: the application software, the update and rollback path, and how tens of thousands of devices behave in senior living communities. When a device goes down in a community, it's a resident safety issue, and your team owns the outcome. Hardware & Firmware own everything below the OS, and you'll work closely with them and our JDM partner. We're open to different levels of leadership experience and will calibrate the scope and level of the role based on the strengths and experience of the person we hire. What You'll Do Fleet reliability and operations: Define the SLOs (uptime, time-to-recover, OTA success, cloud-dark rate, crash-loop rate), build the telemetry to measure them, and run the operating rhythm: on-call, incident response, postmortems. OTA and release engineering: Own updates, staged rollouts, health checks, and rollback across multiple hardware generations, silicon vendors, and both MCU and Linux devices. Device application platform: Own the embedded Linux application layer (services, containers, configuration, connectivity, on-device inference runtime) and the application logic on MCU devices (LoRaWAN/BLE, pendant and beacon behavior). Keep it decoupled from hardware revisions so your team ships without waiting on firmware or board cycles. Partnership with Hardware, Firmware, and the JDM: Make sure JDM-delivered firmware is something we can build on, and embed your engineers in NPI from bring-up so the people who sustain a device are there when it comes alive. Team building: Own org design, hiring, and career growth for the embedded software team, and set the norms (joint definition of done, shared on-call across the hardware/software seam, clear code ownership) that make cross-team ownership work. title: Director of Demand Generation
description: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. We have a best-in-market product story, strong creative assets, and stellar copywriting. Now we need the person who gets it in front of the right people. We're looking for a Director of Demand Generation to own signup growth across paid and organic, the number that fuels Help Scout’s growth. As we move into the mid-market, you’ll decide how we reach customers we’ve never reached before, and you’ll prove it with results. The right person will identify and expand what's working, and add new and creative strategies to reach customers we aren't reaching yet. You'll also lead a small team, manage our agency partners, and work closely with Sales, RevOps, and Content. You'll report to the VP of Marketing and be accountable for tangible growth. Success looks like growth in signups, signup-to-paid conversion, and pipeline from target accounts. What you'll do Own signup growth across paid and organic. Set the targets, build the quarterly and annual plan to hit them, and report on results. Lead our upmarket demand strategy. Define how we find, reach, and convert larger customers through new inbound and outbound motions. Build the plan from what we already know about the customers we serve today. Build and run ABM with Sales and Marketing. Partner on target account selection, coordinated campaigns, and the handoffs that turn engagement into pipeline. Evolve what's working and add to it. Scale and sharpen our existing paid and organic programs across search, social, and display, including creative, bidding, and budget, while testing new strategies alongside them. Lead SEO and organic acquisition. Own SEO strategy and the team behind it, and partner with Content to turn organic traffic and on-site conversion into predictable signups. Shape how Help Scout shows up in AI-driven discovery. As buyers move from search engines to AI assistants, make sure we're the answer (AEO). Find the channels we're not using yet. Test new ways to reach the right audience: communities, partnerships, gifting, affiliate, influencers, events, direct mail, out-of-home. Build the case, run the test, then scale it or kill it fast. Run a high-velocity experimentation program. Test landing pages, offers, signup flows, and messaging with clear hypotheses and fast decisions. Connect effort to revenue. Work with Sales and RevOps on attribution so we know which channels and accounts turn into pipeline and paying customers. Build the future of the function. Own a 12–18 month demand gen roadmap, including where to invest, which agencies to use, and when to hire. About you You have 7+ years in demand generation, growth, or performance marketing, with direct ownership of signup or pipeline targets at a B2B SaaS company You've taken a product-led or self-serve company upmarket, building inbound and outbound programs that reached a new, larger customer segment. You've run ABM hands-on, in close partnership with Sales. You have deep paid expertise across search, social, and display, and a strong command of how SEO, content, and AEO drive acquisition. You’ve managed people, whether direct reports, agencies, or both. You think in outcomes. You can point to specific results you drove and explain how you got them. You are creative by nature. You've found a channel or tactic others missed and made it work. You’re scrappy and resourceful. You get strong results from modest budgets and you're comfortable with ambiguity. You have strong analytics skills (GA4, GTM, attribution tools). You make decisions with data and know its limits. You use AI tools daily and can give concrete examples of how they've changed your work. You're a clear writer and communicator. Help Scout runs on writing, and you'll thrive in a remote, async team. Company values We care deeply Help Scout has always been built on care, for our customers and for each other. We measure that care by its impact: what our work actually does for the businesses we serve and the people we work alongside. That still means sweating the little details, whether we're tackling a tough request in the queue or offering a teammate feedback. We make each other better The best people here are multipliers. They make everyone around them better, and they do it on purpose. Working remotely makes that harder and more important, so we're open with our work, direct with each other, and generous with what we know. We reinvent how we work What’s possible keeps evolving, and we treat that as an invitation. We experiment and find new and better ways to get work done. Through all of it, our judgment stays at the center of what we ship. We own the outcome When something is ours, we see it through. Every important piece of work has one clear owner who is accountable for the result, not just the effort, including what happens after the work is done. We keep our commitments, raise problems early, and when we miss, we own it without pointing elsewhere. We expect quality and speed together, and we hold each other to that standard. title: Chemical Data Scientist
description: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database. You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. Role Responsibilities: Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources. Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage Experience & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets. Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data Familiarity with building or applying matching, deduplication, or classification models (traditional ML or LLM-based approaches) Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to accelerate data extraction, enrichment, or engineering workflows Startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership — comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment with ambiguous, evolving priorities Compensation Additional Information Salary Range: Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role. Benefits: Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera. Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

description: Senior Software Engineer (Backend Applications) We are a global digital innovation agency for the Intelligence Age, specializing in digital product development, brand transformation, media, and communications for major companies. Our Technology team is an integral part of our business; they are perpetual problem solvers, always seeking new and innovative ways to help our creatives bring their ideas to life. We work across a diverse range of projects, from major website builds and core tech platforms to bespoke experiences and strategic innovation with emerging technologies. About the Role We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on backend applications to be part of our team servicing Google. This role will be responsible for building core services that power major global web experiences, with an emphasis on data ingestion, API design and implementation, and integrations. You’ll be comfortable with a variety of coding languages such as C++ and Python, and will design and scale low-latency RPC/REST microservices, architect globally distributed relational and vector database schemas, build resilient batch data-ingestion pipelines, and own automated CI/CD release workflows from prototype to production. You will act as a core code contributor within a broader team, moving beyond simple feature implementation to architecting reusable systems, performing rigorous code reviews, and ensuring the seamless integration of diverse technologies. The ideal candidate is a specialist who understands the full software development lifecycle and is passionate about delivering high-quality, production-ready code in a collaborative environment. Key Responsabilities On any given day, you will: Design & Evolve API Designs: Design, version, and maintain clean, backward-compatible gRPC and REST/HTTP APIs (supporting multi-version v1/v2 lifecycles), including request/response contracts, deadline budgets, stateless encrypted pagination, and data-governance annotations. Build & Manage High-Performance Serving & Search Features: Build high-concurrency, low-latency backend handlers (using C++ primarily). Optimize hybrid retrieval pipelines that combine full-text search, real-time ML query embeddings, and vector search, with graceful degradation when upstream dependencies degrade. Design Distributed Databases: Architect normalized and interleaved relational schemas, partitioned full-text search indexes, vector indexes, and incremental materialized views on a globally distributed SQL database. Design atomic snapshot/versioning patterns for zero-downtime data updates and instant rollbacks. Manage Scalability & Batch Data Pipelines: Build and operate distributed ETL/batch ingestion pipelines that extract CMS content, perform HTML chunking and rate-limited ML embedding generation, validate data integrity, quarantine malformed records, and bulk-load snapshots at scale. Handle CI/CD, Release Engineering & Observability: Maintain automated build, test, coverage, and progressive rollout pipelines (continuous presubmit, multi-day staging soak phases, and decoupled scheduled data syncs). Collaborate with Frontend Dev & Product Teams: collaborate with other devs to assess product requirements, and translate those into technical specifications. Work with a fullstack team: Collaborate with fullstack web engineers to deliver web experiences leveraging enterprise-grade CMS platforms with custom integrations. Documentation & Technical Mapping : Create documentation to ensure technical clarity, supporting long-term maintenance and team scalability. The Ideal Candidate T-Shaped: You have deep expertise in system application development, but also possess a breadth of skills to collaborate and contribute effectively across web experiences, a variety of backend stacks, and infrastructure design. Product Mindset: You don’t just build features; you build systems. You are passionate about understanding how the solutions you build serve broader product initiatives and outcomes and use product inputs to inform your architecture approach Large-Scale Delivery : You understand the rigor that needs to go into delivering and maintaining scaled applications and core services for major brands, including release orchestration, working closely with QA to remediate issues, and working in an agile environment with a scaled team. Detail-Oriented Craft: You possess a passion for product quality, ensuring that your code is not only functional but also clean, maintainable, and well-tested; and can work autonomously to hold yourself and your work to a high standard. AI-Enabled: You’re comfortable leveraging AI code-assist tools to accelerate your workflow and are interested in integrating AI services where they add genuine value to work efficiency, productivity, and quality. Always Learning: You proactively keep up with modern best practices and concepts, and constantly look for ways to incorporate new approaches into your daily work. You Bring 5+ years of software engineering experience building production backend services. Systems Programming: Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20) and familiarity with Python and SQL. API & Service Design: Proven experience designing versioned RPC (gRPC/Protobuf) and RESTful HTTP APIs, including pagination, input validation, error handling, and backward compatibility. Database Design: Solid foundation in relational database modeling, indexing strategies, query optimization, and transaction/consistency models in distributed SQL systems. CI/CD & Testing: Strong grasp of CI/CD concepts—hermetic unit/integration testing, code coverage, automated presubmits, canary deployments, staged rollouts, and rollback strategies. High-Performance Concurrency: Experience with asynchronous/fiber-based concurrency models, parallel fan-out/fan-in execution, tail-latency optimization, and circuit-breaking/fallback patterns. Search & ML Retrieval Systems: Hands-on experience with full-text search engines, dense vector embeddings, approximate/exact vector indexing, or hybrid ranking (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion). Data Pipelines & Streaming/Batch ETL: Experience building large-scale distributed batch pipelines (e.g., Flume, Beam, Spark) with rate-limited external RPC enrichment and dead-letter/quarantine handling. Privacy & Security Engineering: Familiarity with cryptographic token handling (AEAD), strict PII/user-data access controls, automated TTL/wipeout policies, and auditable production data changes.

title: Head of Sales, SMB
description: About Atomic Atomic is a venture studio and venture capital firm that builds and scales companies from the ground up. We partner with exceptional founders to launch transformative businesses across industries including AI, fintech, healthcare, consumer, enterprise software, and more. We've launched and scaled more than 20 companies including Hims & Hers, Exowatt, Replicant, Found, Golden Child, and Homebound. About the Company An Atomic portfolio company: the all-in-one software platform for an under-penetrated specialty-retail vertical, with point-of-sale, e-commerce, inventory, payments, and compliance in one system of record. 1000+ independent retailers run their stores on it, processing $700M+ in annual card volume. It is part of a permanent-capital software holding company that buys vertical software businesses and rebuilds them as AI-native, backed by Atomic (a $1bn fund and the studio behind Hims & Hers). About the Role You are Head of Sales for this company, and you set the sales playbook for the holding company's first acquisition and every one after it. The market already pulls: with no marketing and almost no outbound, stores still sign up every month. You start as a team of one plus a BDR, sell directly from day one, and build the machine the holding company will install at each business it buys. What You'll Do... Sell, personally: this is not a manage-only seat. You carry your own deals, take the biggest ones, and shape the pitch before the team runs it. Always be closing. Own the whole funnel: inbound, demand gen, and outbound have no owner today; you stand each one up. Build and lead the team: from one to 5-6 in year one; bringing 2-3 AEs you trust is a plus. Help set the number, then own it: no quota in stone yet; you set it with us, then own the forecast. AI-first motion: reps own the conversation and the close; AI does research, follow-up, CRM, and coaching. Write the playbook: the stages, metrics, and weekly cadence the next portfolio company will run. What You'll Bring... Scaled ARR and a sales team from ~$2-5M to $20-30M in SMB SaaS, ideally at a PE-backed company. You've seen this movie before: you built an SMB sales org from scratch and still love to close. True SMB selling: ~$5-20K ACVs to owner-operators, not enterprise; vertical SaaS, POS, or payments a plus. Strong experience with the phone: you love cold outbound, have mastered closing deals on the phone and scaled it across a team, and still get in the trenches cold calling with them. Operating rigor: a clean CRM, an honest forecast, and comp plans that drive the right behavior. AI-native instincts: you already use AI to make reps faster and want to build a team around it. Extreme ownership: you take full accountability for the team, the number, and the outcomes. We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. ----- Atomic is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Please review our CCPA policies here.

title: Front End Developer
description: Remote Front End Developer About SchemeServe For 26 years, SchemeServe has helped transform insurance products into successful, profitable solutions. We’re always looking for new ways to innovate and improve. We strive to challenge industry norms and bring a unique personality to our work. In a nutshell, SchemeServe is a UK-based Insurance SaaS solution specialising in services for starting, managing, and growing traditional (and specialist) insurance products. It was started in 2000 by our CEO and Founder, Adam, and the software now represents the leading edge in super-fast scheme deployment and truly Obsessive Support ™. We’re fully remote, but we get together twice a year for some not-so-serious, and teeny tiny bit of serious, time together. We value self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and take on new challenges. To help with this, we offer learning budgets for courses, books, and workshops. Since we’re remote, we don’t offer free snacks or bean bags, but we do provide flexible work arrangements, a healthy work-life balance, and a friendly company culture. Every Thursday, we have 'Elevenses,' where anyone can join a video call to catch up, share stories, or play games. It helps us stay connected. About the role Enjoy the freedom of remote work while playing a key role in shaping the tools that thousands of brokers and insurers rely on. By enhancing our front-end, you'll improve user interfaces that empower professionals to manage schemes more efficiently and provide excellent service to their clients, all from the comfort of your home. If you're a passionate Front-end Developer in the UK who knows React.js and modern front-end tools, this opportunity could be an excellent fit for you. We’re looking for someone ready to jump in and focus on building user interfaces as part of one of our product teams. Within 6 to 12 months, you’ll help build and modernise core parts of SchemeServe, significantly enhancing our clients' workflow and efficiency. You’ll use React.js, TypeScript, and CSS (including Tailwind CSS) to create reliable, maintainable products. If you’ve done this before and enjoy it, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll primarily work with a product team in an agile manner, which includes back-end and QA engineers, as well as UX designers, a product manager, and an engineering manager. Sometimes, you may also join other front-end projects, so strong communication and people skills are essential. Front-End Developer Responsibilities: Developing new and existing features/ interfaces to enhance the user experience. Building reusable components and front-end libraries for future use. Translating designs and wireframes into high-quality code. Optimising components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers. Maximise pages for speed and scalability. Accurately translate user and business needs into functional frontend code. Liaising with internal & external stakeholders through the life cycle of each project. Maintaining brand consistency throughout the implementation of designs. Front-End Developer Requirements: UK-based: Your presence in the UK helps with tax and data rules, ensuring smooth operations and compliance. 6+ years of experience in front-end development. 3+ years of experience using React. Understanding of key design principles. Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript. Good problem-solving skills demonstrated by delivering solutions to complex challenges. Excellent verbal communication skills to collaborate with diverse teams. Good interpersonal skills to foster a positive team environment. Experience working in an agile development process. Be open to feedback and constructive criticism, and be happy to work collaboratively to improve. Interview Process Experience an interview process designed with collaboration and appreciation at its core. This is your opportunity to showcase how your skills align with what we need, in an environment of mutual respect and partnership. You’ll initially meet your potential future manager along with the Principal of Frontend in a 30-60 minute cultural interview, where both parties can discuss values and work styles openly. We offer a short take-home tech test that allows you to demonstrate your coding skills. This is your chance to present your thought process, leading into a tech interview where we explore your solutions collaboratively. Finally, during an hour-long tech interview, we take a deeper dive into your technical expertise. This session is an exploration of your approach and how it fits with our technological challenge. Note for recruiters We are not currently accepting any candidates from recruiters with whom we do not already have a working agreement. You are welcome to send an email if you really want, but it will be ignored :-) Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Storage Platform Engineer
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK - Integrate networked block storage into our Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration - Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network - Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification - Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors can't degrade other tenants - Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability to hold the system to them - Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching - Keep the platform portable across AWS, other clouds, and bare-metal/colo - Write design docs, mentor engineers, and work closely with the Compute, Branching, Postgres, and Multicloud teams - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and operating storage systems in production - Have built or operated distributed or software-defined block storage (for example Ceph RBD, Lightbits, Simplyblock, Portworx, LINSTOR/DRBD, or an in-house system) - Have hands-on experience with NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, including targets, initiators, multipath, and failover behavior - Have a deep understanding of Linux storage internals: the block layer, io_uring, page cache, O_DIRECT and fsync semantics, filesystems, and device-mapper - Write strong systems code in Go, plus C, C++, or Rust - Measure performance rigorously with fio, pgbench, eBPF, and perf, and can explain latency down to its individual components - Understand durability tradeoffs between replication, erasure coding, and consistency under failure - Have led technical direction on a complex system: design docs, tradeoffs, and bringing others along - Have experience with Kubernetes controllers and/or CSI drivers - Have been on call for large production systems - Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams NICE TO HAVE: - SPDK development experience - RDMA/RoCE experience - Experience implementing block-level snapshots, thin provisioning, or copy-on-write cloning - Postgres internals knowledge (WAL, buffer manager, checkpointer), or familiarity with OrioleDB - Experience with AWS networking and instance storage at scale (ENA, placement, bandwidth limits) - Experience running storage on bare metal or in colo - Contributions to open source storage projects or the Linux kernel storage stack WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
description: About Ema Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. Role Overview We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. You’ll be the connective tissue between our BDR, Sales, AI Strategy, Product Marketing and Design teams, turning live experiences into qualified pipeline. You’ll be Ema’s first field marketer in the region, working alongside our US Field Marketing Manager. Our Marketing Lead sets the global event strategy and budget. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it. We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you. Key Responsibilities Regional Event Planning Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead. Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam. Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent. Event Execution & Operations Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe. Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture. Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI. Pipeline & Sales Alignment Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market. Coordinate pre-event outreach, booth and event activations, and post-event follow-up to drive lead conversion. Make sure every event lead reaches Sales quickly and cleanly. No leads die on the vine. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with AI Strategists, Product Marketing and Design so demos, collateral and messaging are event-ready, on-brand and right for the local audience. Support broader demand-generation campaigns as needed, including regional activations and partner co-marketing events. You’re quick with tools and not afraid to learn new systems. You’re observant , recognize pain points and opportunities, and aren't afraid to step in and lead the charge on improvements. Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection. Wired headset for clear communication. A quiet, distraction-free workspace. Stable power and internet connectivity. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. You’ll help large organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform through strategic, consultative SaaS sales. You’ll engage customers on how Agentic AI, AI orchestration, and integrated security can support secure software development and business outcomes. Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management. description: About Payoneer Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. Ledger & Stablecoin Integration: Design the reconciliation architecture guaranteeing absolute consistency between the fiat subledger, reserve accounts, and on-chain token supply. Build the event messaging layer securely synchronizing core ledger transactions with custody platform mint/burn actions. Technical Leadership: Serve as the technical lead and mentor for the Core Backend team. Establish uncompromising standards for code reviews, testing, observability, and deployment appropriate for a regulated bank. Compliance in the Transaction Path: Integrate automated sanctions screening connectors with auditable screening and case escalation hooks. Resilience & Observability: Partner with the SRE Lead on multi-region availability, failover targets, and real-time ledger alerting. Work with the Security division on IAM, key management interfaces, and threat modeling for mint/burn pipelines. Audit Readiness: Support UAT, feature freezes, and external control validation ahead of the pre-opening exam. Who you are Engineering Depth: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on architecting high-integrity transactional systems (banking core, payments ledger, exchange, or settlement infrastructure). Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of event-driven architecture, exactly-once processing semantics, idempotency, and reconciliation at scale. Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, and multi-region deployment in a regulated or audited environment. Audit-Grade Engineering: Track record designing immutable transaction logs, reconciliation controls, and automated evidence generation for examiners and external auditors. Technical Mentorship: Proven success elevating the technical output of senior engineers, setting architectural standards, and owning delivery end-to-end. Regulator-Ready Documentation: Ability to produce system architecture documentation that withstands intense regulatory and audit scrutiny. Not a must but a great advantage: Digital Asset Systems: Direct experience with stablecoin, digital asset custody, or blockchain settlement systems, including on-chain/off-chain reconciliation. Examination Environments: Familiarity with FFIEC IT examination expectations or SOC 2 audit environments. Why This Role Matters Every dollar of PAYO-USD in circulation depends on the systems this role designs. The Senior Staff Engineer builds the transactional backbone that regulators examine, auditors verify, and merchants trust. The position is eligible for health insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, 401k plan, paid-time off, and sick (and where applicable safe) leave. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we're looking for: • Bring 6 or more years of engineering experience, including ownership of production tools from initial design through deployment and ongoing operation. • Work directly with GTM workflows and systems such as Salesforce, Clay, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, and Gainsight, including their application programming interfaces (APIs) and data models. • Build production agentic applications using prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, tool calling, evaluation frameworks, and observability. • Translate business goals and pain points into clear technical requirements, explain tradeoffs in plain language, and collaborate effectively with non-technical GTM leaders and cross-functional partners. • Write clean, tested, maintainable code and apply strong engineering practices, including version control, code review, debugging, and consistent coding standards. • Deploy and operate production services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), using containers or serverless infrastructure, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), monitoring, and alerting. • Use Structured Query Language (SQL) and data modeling to build reliable data pipelines between systems. title: Director/Senior Director, New Products
description: About Us Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world's largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses. We're based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Goldman Sachs, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, and Y Combinator. We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble, and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building, seeking teammates who are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. As a growth stage startup employee, you'll have the opportunity to build the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners' lives easier by eliminating up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide. About the Role You will be the Director/Senior Director of Fieldguide's internal audit product: own the P&L, set the strategy, and take it from first design partners to a repeatable, multi-million-dollar business. Internal audit teams carry the same capacity problem as external auditors, often with smaller budgets: rising SOX and regulatory scope, new risk areas like AI, cyber and third parties, and a shrinking talent pool. Much of their work (walkthroughs, controls testing, evidence requests, workpapers, issue tracking) looks like the work Fieldguide's agents already execute for audit firms. This role takes that engine to a new buyer: Chief Audit Executives and internal audit leaders at corporations, plus the firms that deliver co-sourced and outsourced internal audit for them. This is not a product management or a sales role. You will make the calls a founder makes: which internal audit workflows to attack first, which companies are the first customers, what to build next and what to kill. You will have a dedicated pod of engineers, designers and internal audit subject-matter experts, and the full weight of Fieldguide's platform, brand and firm relationships behind you. What You'll Do Find the wedge. Spend real time inside internal audit functions with CAEs, audit directors, SOX program leads and staff auditors. Identify the high-volume, high-pain work (SOX controls testing, walkthroughs, evidence collection, risk assessments, operational audits) where an agent can do the job end to end, and decide which problem we win first. Build the product with the pod. Partner with engineering, and design leads and our internal audit SMEs to define what ships, in what order, and what "good enough" means for work that lands in front of audit committees and external auditors. Write the spec when needed; sit in the eval reviews. Land design partners, then customers. Help close the first 5–10 internal audit teams. Turn them into referenceable deployments with measurable hours saved, coverage gained and quality improved. Partner with GTM. Work with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to shape how the product is positioned, sold and expanded: into corporate IA teams directly and through co-sourcing firms already on Fieldguide. Bring the customer insight and proof points they need, and help build a playbook they can run without you. Know the landscape. Understand where incumbent GRC and audit-management tools stop, and position Fieldguide as the system that does the work, not just tracks it. Build the team. Hire the first dedicated GTM, deployment and IA SME roles for the line as it scales. Know when to double down or stop. Run tight experiments, read the signal honestly, and bring the company a clear recommendation. Who You Are 8+ years of experience, including at least one stint taking a product or business from zero to one: as a founder, a GM of a new line, or the first operator on a new product at a high-growth company. Real P&L or revenue ownership, with numbers you can talk through. Strong commercial instinct: you have sold complex B2B software to senior, skeptical buyers and closed deals yourself. Enough technical depth to work as a peer with AI engineers: you understand what agents can and can't do today, and how evals and human review fit in. Clear, structured writing. You turn ambiguity into a crisp memo and a plan people can act on. Bonus Points Background in internal audit, SOX, risk or controls: as a practitioner or leader in a corporate IA function, in a Big Four or Top 100 firm's risk advisory or internal audit practice, or selling into CAEs. CIA or CPA a plus. Experience at a vertical SaaS, GRC or AI-native company between Series B and pre-IPO. Management consulting, investment or strategy background paired with hands-on operating experience. More About Fieldguide Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are: Fearless: Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls. Fast: Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection. Lovable: Deliver happiness and 11 star experiences. Owners: Execute and run the business with ownership. Win-win: Create mutual value and earn trust for life. Inclusive: Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams. Benefits Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership Flexible PTO 401k Wellness benefits, including a bundle of free therapy sessions Technology and Work from Home reimbursement

title: Werkstudent Grafikdesign (m/w/d)
