title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Role Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible. We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet. As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation. You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform. Y our responsibilities will include: Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning. Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation. Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work. Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities. Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation. Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews. Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness. Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system. Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices. Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies. We expect you to have: Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems. Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling. A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production. Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction. Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems. Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example. Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams. We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience. Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure , GPU platforms , or large server fleets would be valuable. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful. We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Support Manager - EMEA
description: Caring deeply about our customers is one of our favourite Ashby Operating Principles in Support. As we continue to grow our Product Support Team with the customer experience at the heart of everything we do, we're excited to hire a Manager of Product Support to our EMEA team. In this role, you'll lead an incredible group of Technical Support Specialists, collaborate closely with a high-performing team of Support Managers, and help shape how we scale exceptional customer support globally. About this role: This is a unique opportunity to join as the second Regional Manager in EMEA, building the support team as we continue to gain significant market share in EMEA. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, has a passion for building and can balance strategic foresight with operational execution. You’ll need to be both a strong advocate for our customers and for your team, as we continue to grow Support in line with our ambitious company goals. Support at Ashby is a unique opportunity to support a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Lovable, Bolt, Mistral and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded , and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks. Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~24% of our global revenue base. Clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform , expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. This is an opportunity to lead a team through an exciting growth phase, and implement systems and processes to set us up for the phase wave of growth. When you start, you’ll work closely with our Director of Support and VP of Customer Success – you’ll inherit a team of ~8 Product Support Specialists and will grow this team further once you’re ramped. Role Requirements: Support Leadership: You have a proven track record of leading and growing high-performing and highly technical B2B SaaS Support organisations, while driving a culture of excellence and empathy. Systematic Thinking: You proactively address thematic customer issues and improve Support processes, leveraging Support technologies and innovative processes to enhance the efficiency and efficacy of the Support team. Customer-Centric: You have a deep understanding of B2B customer needs and have a history of ensuring outstanding support experiences. Strong Technical Background: You have experience working with complex B2B software products and can understand, troubleshoot, and communicate technical concepts effectively. While you may not be an engineer, you are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, and system workflows with technical teams and translating that knowledge into actionable insights for the Support team. Continuous Improvement: You are passionate about driving high standards and strive to make all processes and structures even better. Our managers have led significantly impactful initiatives such as deciding on and shifting to a new ticketing system, collaborating with recruiting to improve our interview process, and implementing SME programs as our product expands in scope. Timely Issue Resolution: You are invested in overseeing the resolution of complex technical issues in alignment of our SLAs. Analytical: You are comfortable using data and metrics to drive decision-making, continually improving both the team and customer experience. Technical Expertise: You are well versed in Support organisations, related KPIs, and related systems (ticketing, analytics, Help Center, etc.). You could be a great fit if: You care deeply about both the customer and employee experience and derive satisfaction from enabling others to be successful. You strive to become a product and industry expert. You align with the goal of creating differentiation via the Support experience and being a go-to partner for your team members. You recognise the expertise the team possesses and are continuously striving to learn and maintain your own expertise in the product. Your peers describe you as being detail-oriented. You take pride in operational efficiencies and consider processes from a holistic perspective. You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy. You love to coach and enable. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help teams grow functionally and expand their technical knowledge. You enjoy analysing the Support journey and identifying opportunities for self-service and delivery improvements. You thrive in representing the voice-of-the-customer as you hone internal processes, as well as advocating for manageable and efficient processes for Support Specialists. You may not want to apply if: You’re excellent at managing existing Support policies and practices, but identifying and rolling out new processes is not an area you’re comfortable with. You do not want to handle customer-facing tickets, whether for escalation or ongoing learning. Managing the daily Support workload according to urgency, SLAs, and staffing is not something you’re interested in. You need close oversight, a clearly carved out roadmap, or step-by-step guidance to succeed. This role requires comfort with ambiguity, initiative and a willingness to roll up your sleeves to build something you're passionate about. You believe there is one right way to provide support and measure success. Our Philosophy: Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell. We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers – whether it be through scaled engagements (e.g. webinars), 1:1 conversations, or through written word (e.g. documentation). We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly. We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. The Interview: At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety: 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team 45 min - Interview with Hiring Manager Take-Home Assessment - one week to complete Final Round: 30 min "Customer Experience" interview with two other Customer Success leaders 30 min "Team Insights" interview with a Support Specialist, and a Support Leader 30 min "Support Management Approach" interview with another Support Leader 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager Chat with Benji, CEO Benefits: You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible. You get to support a product that our customers are truly excited about. Competitive compensation is offered. 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅 Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive! $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's app. This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers. What Will You Build Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys. Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile. Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release. Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability. Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch. Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability. What We're Looking For Strong native iOS experience using Swift. Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users. Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns. Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens. Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality. Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want fully defined tickets. Developers who build screens without caring about user experience. People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance. Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment. People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Data Platform)
description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products. Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform. We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production. At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute. As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it. Your responsibilities will include: Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load. Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance. Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users. Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes. Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams. Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work. We expect you to have: Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability. Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer. Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads. Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome. A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior. The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users. It will be an added bonus if you have: Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems). Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers. Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems. We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Legal Counsel
description: About Us_ // At Masabi , we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ // At Masabi, we're building technology that makes public transport simpler, fairer and more accessible for millions of people. Behind every agency that runs on our platform is a commercial agreement someone had to shape, negotiate and close. As our Legal Counsel, you'll work closely with our General Counsel, leading on our largest and most complex commercial deals. Much of the work follows one opportunity from beginning to end. It starts with major tenders and public procurements, where you'll shape our position on the terms we can work with and the ones worth challenging. From there you'll take the deal through negotiation to signature, with colleagues across the business bringing the commercial and technical detail. Underneath runs the advisory side: data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the questions that come with operating across several markets. You'll work directly with our CEO, CFO and CPO, helping them see risk clearly and decide quickly. Legal is a close-knit team, so you'll have genuine influence over how we work. Our biggest markets are the UK and North America, though we work well beyond both, so the jurisdictions and deal types will vary. Location_ // This role is available on a remote basis for candidates located anywhere in the UK. Candidates based in London may also work in a hybrid model, with occasional travel to the office. Responsibilities_ Take the lead on the legal side of major tenders and public procurements, shaping our position on the terms and where we're willing to move Lead the negotiation and close of our largest customer contracts, working with colleagues across the business to settle the commercial, technical and operational detail alongside the legal Carry major opportunities from first look through to a signed contract Draft and negotiate across our full commercial range, including SaaS and licensing, implementation and professional services, NDAs, data processing terms, and partnership and reseller agreements Advise the business on data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the commercial questions that come up day to day Work directly with our CEO, CFO and CPO, translating legal risk into commercial choices they can act on Use our AI and agentic tooling as part of how you work, and help shape where Legal takes it next Step in for our General Counsel during periods of leave, or when he's committed elsewhere About You_ You hold a law degree and a current practising certificate, qualified in the UK, the US, or a Commonwealth jurisdiction such as Australia, New Zealand, Ireland or Canada Several years in practice since qualifying You have strong, hands-on experience drafting and negotiating complex technology contracts, particularly SaaS, and have led those negotiations yourself Communicates with precision, giving you a clear answer to a senior stakeholder without unnecessary detail You're comfortable across a broad remit, moving between a major negotiation and a smaller advisory question in the same day Has worked across more than one jurisdiction You think ahead as well as answering what's in front of you, when the same issue keeps coming back, you'd rather change how it's handled than answer it a third time Builds trust easily across a business, so people tend to bring you in early rather than once a decision is already made You're interested in how AI can support legal work, with a clear sense of where judgement stays with you Trusts your own judgement on risk, and you're comfortable standing by it You can have the harder conversations with senior people and come out of them on good terms We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work. Nice To Have_ Public sector procurement experience, particularly in North America Experience in public transport, mobility, fare collection, payments or another regulated infrastructure environment Several years in private practice before moving in-house AI at Masabi_ // AI is becoming part of how we work at Masabi. You don’t need professional experience using AI tools, but we’d expect you’ve experimented with them and are curious about how they can help you learn, solve problems, and work more effectively. Some of Our Benefits_ 25 days of holiday per year plus the option to buy another 5 days, pro-rated Private healthcare via AXA, including pre-existing conditions and mental health Life insurance Menopause support Choice of workstation The ability to work for up to 3 months per year from any country in the world (certain limitations apply) Pension scheme Training allowance of up to £1000 per year £200 annual allowance for any home office need or improvement Enhanced family leave pay Cycle to work scheme Regular social gatherings with a monthly allowance for each employee A fun and collaborative environment with a focus on making a difference in the world Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all. // We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work. Whoever you are, just be yourself. // We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions. Why Join Masabi? Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are. Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey. Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load. We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | NORD
description: At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple. The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf. What you’ll do at Jamf: The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive NORDICS is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships. This role is offered in Sweden only , preferably for candidates located and used to travel from the Stockholm area #LI-Remote What you can expect to do this role: New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory. Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts. Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline. Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets. Enterprise Sales Cycle Management Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes. Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts. Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy. Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders. Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences. Commercial & Deal Execution Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind. Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests. Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence. Partner & Ecosystem Engagement Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution. Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations. Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting. Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines. Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge. What we are looking for: Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required) Professional working proficiency in English and Swedish (required) Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required) Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required) Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required) Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required) Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required) Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required) Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred) Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred) Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred) Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred) Travel in the NORDICS territory around 40%. SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory. Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches. Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf. Why Jamf? Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021. We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf. We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities. You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf. We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team. You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world. We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us. We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful. 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes). What it means to be a Jamf? We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace. Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly. Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. What does Jamf do? Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day. Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
description: Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby . I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success. We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward. Role overview: We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you. As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team. Role requirements: UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates. Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place. People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit. Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint. Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently. Compensation Expertise : You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions. Performance Management : You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles. Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees. Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk. You could be a great fit if: 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions. ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence Bonus points if you have: An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification This role may not be a fit if: You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby. Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job. Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments. You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams. Interview process Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is: Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes) People Ops team interview (45 minutes) Take-home assignment (1 hour) People Leader interview (45 minutes) Virtual onsite (2–3 hours) Benefits Competitive salary and equity. 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby -do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited holiday with five weeks recommended per year on top of UK bank holidays. Expect "Holiday?" on our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅 A generous budget for equipment, software, and office furniture. Get what you need to be happy and productive! Top-notch supplemental health insurance (private medical and dental) for you and your dependents, with premiums covered by us, plus company-paid life insurance + income protection, and a workplace pension with a 3% Ashby contribution. Generous family leave. You'll get your full statutory family leave entitlement, and Ashby pays the first 12 weeks at 100%. £100/month education budget, with bigger items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. Ashby's success depends on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We're being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Backend Software Engineer - AI Finance Agent
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent. This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users. What You'll Own Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app. Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services. Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations. Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly. Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners. Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance. Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products. What We're Looking For 3+ years of backend engineering experience. Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging. Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems. Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases. Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk. Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams. Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams. Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact. Can move fast without creating fragile foundations. Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability. Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks. People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk. Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements. Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems. People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Professional Services Engagement Manager
description: About Ping Identity : At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. As a Professional Services Engagement Manager, you will report to the Director of Professional Services and will play an essential role in Professional Services' commitment to deliver successfully on engagements striving for predictability, repeatability and financial responsibility. We are looking for someone who enjoys leading engagements for external clients and one who can manage a portfolio of complex projects. This is a hybrid role that will require 50% of your time to be spent in hands-on project management and 50% of the time to be spent in services sales. You will have several years of experience in project management best practices, consulting, and leading technology implementation projects. You will join a highly effective team with a focus towards team work, successful deployments and outstanding cooperation with our go-to-market teams. Our goal is not just to make our customers successful, but to take your project management skillset to the next level. You will: Be the primary point of contact overseeing engagements delivered by Ping Professional Services. Build relationships with customers, partners, and our go-to-market teams Manage a portfolio of projects for successful delivery outcomes, revenue and profitability. Manage outcomes to resolve issues, conflicts, risks, and dependencies Flourish in a collaborative environment, demonstrating teamwork and excellence Provide written/verbal status updates to customer, partners and leadership on key project metrics Support revenue forecasting, invoicing and resourcing efforts for the Professional Services team Be an active member of project governance setup Support new services sales effort by attaching professional services offerings to new deals. Establish, monitor and manage own services sales pipeline Participate in regional license and services sales forecasting Define and present business value of services deals Scope complex custom services engagements together with technical consultants Understand and apply meaningful commercial incentives for services deals Requirements: You have: 5 years of project management experience in consulting and technology implementation Motivated and comfortable adapting to change and competing demands with timelines Bachelor's Degree Exceptional skills around communications and delivery Can independently deliver results Commercial mindset Desired Qualifications Experience with the technical implementations PMP Certification Business or technology consulting background Experience motivating teams Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. Global volunteering and community initiatives Our Benefits: Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule Parental Leave Progressive Healthcare Options Retirement Programs Opportunity for Education Reimbursement Commuter Offset (Specific locations) Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: 1192 - Sr. BIM Software Developer
description: We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. We need an English-fluent Sr. BIM Software Developer , based in Latin America, available to work remotely. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills. Are you the one we are looking for? Responsibilities: Build and support internal web applications using ASP.NET. Automate repetitive tasks and data workflows with PowerShell and Python scripts. About the Role We are hiring a Founding Performance Marketing Lead to own performance and growth marketing from the ground up. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build the machine - not inherit one. You will have the autonomy to test quickly, scale what works, stop what does not, and turn learning into repeatable playbooks. What You'll Own 1. Personally manage meaningful media spend and make channel decisions based on pipeline quality, acquisition economics, and revenue - not vanity metrics. 2. Turn creative into a growth system Build a high-velocity testing engine across short-form video, UGC, founder-led creative, static ads, customer proof, use-case creative, case studies, and landing-page concepts. Develop a repeatable process for creative briefs, production, testing, learning, and iteration. 3. Own the conversion funnel Build and continuously improve the journey from ad to landing page to demo or trial to activation. Create and ship landing pages without waiting on a large web team, and work with Product and Design to remove friction from high-intent conversion paths. 4. Make measurement and attribution decision-grade Own campaign tracking, UTMs, pixels, events, conversion APIs, CRM campaign logic, attribution models, dashboards, and funnel reporting. Create a clear view of what is producing qualified pipeline, what is wasting spend, and where conversion is breaking down. 5. Run a disciplined experimentation program Design and execute continuous A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, creative, copy, audiences, offers, landing pages, CTAs, forms, demo flows, and channel mix. Maintain an experiment backlog and use data to decide what to scale, iterate, or kill. 6. Discover and codify our best audiences Identify the ICP signals, personas, use cases, pain points, messages, offers, and targeting strategies that consistently produce high-quality opportunities. Turn those findings into reusable audience and messaging playbooks for Marketing and Sales. 7. Help shape product-led growth Partner with Product and Revenue on activation, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid pathways, in-product prompts, lifecycle nudges, and other early PLG loops that can complement the sales-led motion. 8. Automate for leverage Use AI, no-code/low-code tools, enrichment, workflow automation, and light scripting to increase testing velocity and reduce repetitive work. Build a marketing operating system that can test 20 thoughtful ideas where a traditional team might test two. The Numbers You'll Care About Qualified Pipeline CAC / CAC Payback CPL / Cost per Qualified Lead ARR Sourced / Influenced Conversion Rate LTV / CAC Pipeline Velocity Experiment Win Rate Clicks, CTR, engagement, and reach matter only when they help explain the economics of acquiring customers and creating revenue. Who We're Looking For 4-8+ years of hands-on performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, HR Tech, recruiting technology, or another high-growth technology category. A track record of personally managing and scaling approximately $50K-$250K+ per month in paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, or comparable channels - and translating that spend into qualified pipeline and revenue. Deep hands-on experience inside ad platforms. You can build campaigns, audiences, conversion tracking, creative tests, budgets, bids, and optimization logic yourself. Demonstrated ability to connect channel spend to downstream funnel performance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and ARR. Strong command of funnel economics, including CPL, CAC, LTV, CAC payback, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and marginal acquisition efficiency. Experience building and improving landing pages, forms, demo flows, or trial experiences with a strong CRO mindset. Strong creative instincts and copy judgment. You can diagnose why a message or creative concept is working - not merely report that CTR changed. Experience testing video, UGC, creator-led, founder-led, or short-form paid creative. Comfort with analytics, dashboards, CRM data, experimentation, attribution, and imperfect early-stage datasets. Ability to move quickly from hypothesis to launch to data to insight to the next test. Strong written communication and the ability to translate customer pain into clear, high-converting messaging. A builder mentality: high ownership, low ego, strong judgment, and a preference for creating the playbook rather than waiting for one. Bonus Points If You Have Built performance marketing from near-zero at an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company. Scaled one or more paid channels into a predictable source of qualified pipeline while maintaining disciplined acquisition economics. Experience in HR Tech, recruiting technology, AI, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or another complex B2B category. Built a UGC, creator, customer-proof, or founder-led creative program that materially improved paid performance. Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce; Webflow or Framer; GA4; Segment; Mixpanel or Amplitude; Clay; Zapier or Make; and modern attribution or ad-tracking tools. Built lightweight automations, scripts, dashboards, or AI-assisted workflows yourself. Worked with Product teams on PLG, free-trial, self-service, lifecycle, or activation experiments. Used AI tools systematically to accelerate research, creative production, analysis, personalization, and experimentation. You'll Thrive Here If You want meaningful ownership and are energized by a blank sheet of paper. You enjoy being in the campaigns, creative, landing pages, dashboards, and funnel - not only managing vendors. You are comfortable being accountable for qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes. You prefer fast, instrumented experiments over long planning cycles. You can balance speed with analytical rigor and know when the data is strong enough to act. You are resourceful and can ship with a small team while building systems that scale. What Success Looks Like A repeatable paid acquisition engine is producing qualified demand at increasingly predictable economics. Campaign-to-CRM attribution provides a credible view from spend through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue. Creative and landing-page experiments are shipping every week with documented learnings. Neuroscale has a clear picture of its highest-converting ICPs, personas, messages, offers, and channel combinations. Landing-page, demo/trial, and funnel conversion rates are improving through systematic experimentation. CAC and payback are understood by channel and audience, with clear thresholds for scaling spend. A measurable content and creative engine supports paid acquisition rather than operating as a separate activity stream. Marketing, Product, Sales, and Revenue Operations share a common funnel definition and growth scorecard. A documented growth playbook compounds as spend, headcount, and market coverage increase. Why Neuroscale Build at the moment growth becomes the priority. The product foundation is in place. The opportunity now is to build the acquisition engine that can turn strong technology into a category-defining company. Founding-level ownership. You will not be optimizing someone else's mature playbook. The systems, experiments, and operating cadence you create can become the foundation of Neuroscale's future growth organization. Direct access to the founders. Work closely with company leadership with very little organizational friction between a strong idea and testing it in market. AI-native environment. You will market an AI company inside a team that expects AI to be embedded in how research, creative, analysis, automation, and decision-making get done. High autonomy with clear accountability. This is a high-trust role for someone who wants the freedom to move quickly and the responsibility to own measurable outcomes. A path to broader growth leadership. This role is designed to expand with results, with a fast path toward Head of Growth as the company scales. The Opportunity Most performance marketing roles ask you to improve an existing engine by 10-20%. This role gives you the chance to build the engine. The campaigns you launch, audiences you discover, creative systems you create, attribution infrastructure you establish, and growth loops you uncover can define how Neuroscale acquires customers for years. Compensation & Growth This is a founding-level, high-impact role with compensation designed to align with measurable growth and long-term value creation. Specific base compensation, performance incentives, equity or long-term participation, and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates and finalized based on experience, location, and employment structure. The role is designed to create a path toward broader Head of Growth leadership as Neuroscale scales. How We Hire We value evidence of outcomes over polished marketing language. Strong candidates should be prepared to walk through campaigns they personally built, the economics behind them, what they tested, what failed, what they changed, and how those decisions affected pipeline or revenue. Introductory conversation focused on fit, ownership, and growth-stage experience. Deep dive into one or two performance programs you personally operated. Practical working session or case discussion focused on audience, creative, funnel, and measurement strategy. Final conversation with the founders on scope, operating style, and growth mandate. Equal Opportunity Neuroscale AI is committed to building a team based on capability, potential, and impact. title: Senior Treasury Product Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/UK Remote | 💰 £56,100 - 75,900 (depending on your experience) + Incentive Award tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Treasury product control analyst to join our Financial operations & control team. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant looking for a first-time move from practice to industry and/or who has an understanding of Treasury products in the context of a banking environment. This understanding includes but is not exhaustive to Treasury investment securities, derivative instruments (interest rate swaps and FX forwards), hedge accounting and financial reporting.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges coming up like continued expansion into the European Union, growing our customer base, keep growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. This all leads to exciting Treasury activity to support this growth whilst managing risk. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Head of Treasury Product Control. </p> <p><strong>🔑  You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working very closely with our Treasury front office, treasury operations and financial control teams as we continue to build our treasury product control capabilities in Finance.</li> <li>Taking ownership of the end-to-end control processes on Treasury products. This includes:</li> <ul> <li>Independent trade confirmation for all Treasury deals booked in our Treasury Management System (TMS)</li> <li>Daily collateral management for our derivative and REPO portfolios </li> <li>Daily profit and loss reporting on Treasury income to CFO/Treasuer</li> <li>Valuation controls around Treasury financial instrument pricing</li> </ul> <li>Managing Treasury month-end processes, including derivatives and hedge accounting. </li> <li>Maintaining existing and developing new treasury related internal controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process, working with 2LoD and 3LoD along the way.</li> <li>Supporting our year end processes, preparing Treasury related disclosures, dealing with external audit queries and ad hoc assistance on non-Treasury related aspects of the cycle. </li> <li>Understanding the Treasury business and their products to write insightful management commentary on results.</li> <li>Reviewing new Treasury products, assessing and determining the accounting treatment before implementing the GL configuration mapping in our TMS.</li> <li>Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of this role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.</li> <li>Learning SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Ad hoc support on non-Treasury related initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you..</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant and have knowledge and/or understanding of Treasury products in a banking context.</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail and a thirst to learn, which sees you develop into the subject matter for all things Treasury.</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key internal controls.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s confirming trade accuracy or pulling together complex disclosures in a simplified way for derivatives in our annual report.</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus).</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>💰 </strong>£56,100 - £75,900 (depending on experience) + Incentive Award tied to your performance. </li> <li><strong>📍</strong>This role can be based in our London or Cardiff offices. We're also open to distributed working within the UK (with the expectation of some travel to our London office).</li> <li>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</li> <li>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</li> </ul> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits.</a></p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Call. </li> <li>30 Minute Initial Interview with the Hiring Manager. </li> <li>45 Minute Role Specific Interview.</li> <li>45 Minute Behavioural Interview.</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3 - 4 weeks, your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo 🤖 You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-NZ1 #LI-Remote<br><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
