title: GTA VI Researcher
description: What is Kalshi ? Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. Role Roadmap This is a real job. We’re looking for someone whose parents said video games would never pay the bills. They were wrong, and you can tell them we said so. As Kalshi’s GTA VI Researcher, you’ll begin at midnight on November 19 and play until you beat the story. You’ll stream the entire journey, investigate Leonida’s economy, and study what happens to the real economy when everyone suddenly has a “family emergency” on launch day. We want the person who finds the optimal money-making strategy, builds a spreadsheet to prove it, and gets accused of ruining the game for everyone else. What You’ll Do Lock in for live launch. Launch-night stream starts at midnight, then play through the story at your own pace. Sleep and touching grass are both allowed (your schedule, your call). Streams on Twitch or YouTube, cam on (thatʼs the deliverable format). How you run your stream is up to you. An official State of the Leonida Economy address, based on your study of the Leonida economy. Real-world fallout analysis: who called in “sick,” how DoorDash carried the entire nation through launch week, and how much productivity America lost. Min-max everything. Find whatʼs broken, whatʼs mid, and whatʼs actually goated, and bring receipts. Drop a weekly research report on the Leonida economy. What You Bring An established gamer and streamer with your own channel: 18+ years of life IRL, 10+ years of sweaty gaming, 3+ years of streaming experience. Your own setup (equipment, internet, and software). You need to know how a system works, how to optimize it, and whether the guide everyone is following is actually wrong. Fees $100,000-120,000 fixed project fee. $15,000 project completion fee. Our Culture Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: Enumerate is seeking a hands-on Product Marketing Manager to turn our software, payments, AI, and accounting services into clear, compelling customer value. You will develop differentiated messaging, execute product launches, build customer proof, and equip Sales and Customer Success with the tools they need to succeed. Reporting to the CMO, you will work closely with product, sales, customer success, and marketing leadership to align vision, priorities, and execution. You will bring customer insight, strong writing, and practical execution to work that serves management company leaders and association board members. This full-time, salaried role is remote-eligible, but candidates must be located in the United States. What You Will Do Positioning & Messaging: Develop and refine differentiated positioning and messaging for Enumerate’s software, payments, AI, and accounting services in partnership with the CMO. Connect individual offerings into a cohesive platform story, tailor value propositions to priority buyers, and apply approved messaging consistently across key sales and marketing touchpoints. Customer, Market & Competitive Insight: Conduct customer and buyer interviews, win/loss analysis, and competitive research to understand purchase drivers, objections, and unmet needs. Translate findings into messaging recommendations, competitive guidance, and actionable input for Product and Marketing. Support CMO-led refinement of ideal customer profiles and buyer personas. Go-to-Market Execution: Lead cross-functional planning and execution for prioritized product launches and feature releases. Partner with Product, Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Success to define audiences, messaging, launch deliverables, readiness requirements, and success measures. Review post-launch results and recommend improvements. Customer Proof: Partner with Customer Marketing and Customer Success to develop case studies, references, customer stories, and ROI narratives that substantiate differentiation and help buyers understand the value of Enumerate’s offerings. Sales & Customer Success Enablement: Create and maintain practical playbooks, pitch decks, battlecards, discovery guides, and objection-handling materials. Train GTM teams on buyer needs, platform positioning, competitive differentiation, and value-based selling. Gather field feedback to keep materials relevant and useful. Product Education & Content: Develop educational content and execute priority product webinars in partnership with Customer Marketing, Customer Success, and subject-matter experts. Translate product capabilities and industry challenges into clear content that supports prospect education and customer adoption. Strategic Marketing Initiatives: Partner with the CMO on high-priority initiatives, including implementing updated ICP positioning and developing product messaging and content for a major website redesign. Collaborate with the teams responsible for program delivery to keep product stories accurate, differentiated, and customer-focused. Measurement & Continuous Improvement: Agree on success measures with the CMO and cross-functional partners for priority projects. Use customer feedback, sales insights, campaign results, and available product-usage data to evaluate effectiveness and improve messaging, launch execution, and enablement. What You Bring 4–6 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or vertical software, with demonstrated ownership of messaging, launches, and sales enablement deliverables. Ability to translate complex products and services into clear, differentiated value propositions for distinct buyer audiences. Hands-on experience conducting customer or buyer research and using competitive insights to improve messaging and GTM execution. A track record of planning and executing cross-functional product launches, with clear goals and evidence of results. Strong writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to personally create customer-facing content and practical sales materials. Ability to manage multiple agreed priorities, coordinate stakeholders, and independently move projects from brief to delivery. Comfort using qualitative and quantitative information to evaluate results and make actionable recommendations. Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day marketing work, with demonstrated examples of improving research, content development, or execution workflows. Ability to critically evaluate outputs, verify claims, and apply sound judgment rather than rely on unedited AI-generated content. Ability to present clear recommendations, explain tradeoffs, and collaborate effectively with senior leadership. Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Preferred Experience Experience with vertical SaaS or multi-product platforms serving small, midsize and enterprise businesses. Familiarity with payments, accounting services, community association management, or property-management workflows. Experience marketing AI-powered capabilities and translating technical features into practical customer benefits. Experience developing customer case studies, ROI stories, product webinars, or website product content. About Enumerate Enumerate is a best-in-class provider of property management software and payments solutions for community associations. We make it easier to run associations by digitizing and optimizing their accounting processes, operational workflows, AR & AP payments, and resident engagement, ultimately reducing administrative tasks by over 75%. With tens of thousands of communities and millions of homes managed, Enumerate is a leader in supporting communities across America. Enumerate was born from industry veterans joining together to operate under the most comprehensive end-to-end offering in the community association management market. As the only player offering a combination of SaaS, Services and Payments products, we are creating a modern, digitally native experience for both homeowners and property managers and are uniquely positioned for continued growth in a category that is already growing 25-30% YoY. The pay range is inclusive of base salary plus any applicable bonuses or commissions. Total compensation pay range (annual salary): $115,000—$140,000 USD

title: Accounting Operations
description: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam. Role Overview You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow. Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaid’s entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination. Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood. Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness. Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests. Qualifications 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred. Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers; Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting; Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches. Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Hands-on, can-do attitude , willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution. Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations. Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to shift priorities quickly. title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. with long, procurement-driven sales cycles relevant to GitLab's Public Sector segments and approach.</li> <li value="7">Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation and OTE.</li> <li value="8">Coach less experienced recruiters and improve recruiting practices by sharing reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Senior-level recruiting experience, with a track record of independently owning full-cycle searches and handling complex, hard-to-fill roles.</li> <li value="2">Public Sector, federal, or government-focused sales recruiting experience, or deep familiarity with government sales segments, quotas, OTE, ramp time, territory design, and procurement-driven sales cycles.</li> <li value="3">Working knowledge of how citizenship, clearance, and background investigation requirements affect sourcing, interview timing, and offer-to-start timelines.</li> <li value="4">Experience building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations at the manager level and above.</li> <li value="5">Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines in niche or credential-restricted talent markets, using funnel insights to guide practical actions.</li> <li value="6">Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li value="7">Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, Metaview, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, or comparable platforms. Ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li value="8">Technology or business-to-business (B2B) software recruiting experience is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You'll join a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. title: Account Executive, Product Sales Specialist (Identity) - Switzerland
description: <h3 data-lfile-container="50e5774d-d563-4a55-8f08-ef895f573991" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About the Team & Role</h3> <p>Identity is now the front door for attackers, and organisations across government, financial services, healthcare and critical infrastructure rely on Rubrik to recover quickly when identity systems like Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta and Ping Identity are compromised. As an Account Executive, Identity Resilience in Switzerland, you'll take a category-defining product to customers in some of the most regulated markets in the world, building a new revenue stream alongside the Identity Sales Specialist team and shaping how Rubrik wins in identity from the earliest stage of the motion.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Own and exceed your identity resilience quota across Switzerland, turning identity into a core part of every strategic security conversation with your customers.</li> <li>Build and execute territory plans for Identity Resilience, prioritising the accounts and verticals that feel identity risk most acutely, so Rubrik is in front of the right buyers at the right moment.</li> <li>Lead executive conversations with CISOs, CIOs and identity and infrastructure leaders, creating urgency around Active Directory and Entra ID recovery and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.</li> <li>Generate and develop pipeline through outbound prospecting, existing Rubrik relationships and joint account planning with Account Executives and Sales Engineers, so identity becomes part of the conversation from the first meeting.</li> <li>Work with channel partners, GSIs and specialist resellers to build joint plays that extend Rubrik's reach beyond what the direct motion can achieve alone.</li> <li>Partner with Sales Engineers to run discovery, demonstrations and proofs of value that translate technical identity attack paths into clear business risk and measurable resilience.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline hygiene, and share what you learn from the field with Product and Marketing so competitive insight and regional requirements shape the roadmap and messaging.</li> <li>Share your identity expertise with colleagues across the field and help enable the wider sales team to lead with identity, growing your own influence as the motion scales.</li> </ul> <h3>Experience You'll Need</h3> <ul> <li>Substantial experience selling identity security, IAM, privileged access or adjacent cybersecurity solutions into enterprise and public sector customers, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota.</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex, executive-level sales cycles with CISOs and senior security and infrastructure stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the identity threat landscape, including Active Directory and Entra ID attack paths, and the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.</li> <li>Experience building pipeline in a new or emerging product category, with the self-direction to create momentum where no playbook yet exists.</li> <li>Experience working with partners, resellers or GSIs to influence and co-sell into target accounts.</li> <li>Comfort operating within the regulatory environment and buying culture of the Swiss market.</li> <li>Language: professional fluency in German and English, written and spoken.</li> <li>Education: bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>Willingness to travel regularly for customer, partner and field engagements.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience selling in the cyber resilience, data security or identity recovery space, including familiarity with identity security and AD recovery vendors.</li> <li>Established relationships with GSIs, identity-focused partners and security-focused resellers in Switzerland and the wider DACH region.</li> <li>Experience with channel-led and partner-influenced selling models.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-remote #LI-CH2</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> | <a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled</h2> <p>Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.</p> <p>Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact <a ----- ----- Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">EEO IS THE LAW</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/olms/regs/compliance/eo_posters/employeerightsposter2page_19final.pdf" target="_blank">NOTIFICATION OF EMPLOYEE RIGHTS UNDER FEDERAL LABOR LAWS</a></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Executive Assistant, Office of the CTO
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As an Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Chief Technology Officer (CTO) organization, you support senior engineering leaders, and report to a Staff Executive Business Administrator in the CTO organization. These leaders are responsible for advancing product capabilities, reliability and operational excellence, GitLab’s next-generation architecture, scaling the business, and accelerating R&D hiring. You keep their priorities aligned through scheduling, meeting preparation, clear communication, and follow-through. In your first year, you build trusted relationships across their teams and with partner EBAs. You establish reliable processes for meeting preparation and follow-through, travel, expenses, recruiting coordination, team events and offsites, and the cross-functional requests that come with customer escalations. This role is based in the United States or Canada and requires Pacific time hours (about 8 AM to 5 PM PT) and some flexibility to support meetings across global time zones. Travel is expected a few times a year (about two to three trips) for offsites and events.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Manage complex calendars for your assigned leaders across time zones. Vet requests, resolve conflicts, recommend tradeoffs, and protect time for focused work and breaks in line with GitLab’s meeting practices.</li> <li>Maintain regular communication with each leader and track updates from direct reports, peers, and cross-functional partners. Flag dependencies, upcoming deliverables, and items that need review, decisions, or escalation before they slip.</li> <li>Plan and execute all-hands, ask-me-anything sessions, organizational summits, leadership offsites, and team-level engineering events, including hands-on support for our annual R&D summit (1,000+ attendees). Coordinate logistics, agendas, speakers, content, and post-event follow-up with partner executive business administrators across Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.</li> <li>Support hiring for senior technical roles by coordinating interview loops, debriefs, executive closing calls, and candidate communication across time zones. Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, Information Technology, and Security on onboarding and team logistics.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, visas, security needs, and supporting documentation. Anticipate disruptions, arrange alternatives, and process accurate expense reports and reimbursements on time.</li> <li>Improve administrative processes, documentation, and leadership trackers so priorities and next steps stay clear. Provide coverage and share practices across the executive business administrator community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting VP-level or senior leaders, ideally in a fast-paced software, SaaS or AI environment (engineering or CTO exposure is a plus), with an understanding of their planning cycles and reviews.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars, travel, expenses, and shifting priorities for multiple senior leaders, with sound judgment about competing requests.</li> <li>Experience running all-hands and offsites end to end for teams of 200 or more in a remote or hybrid setting, including managing dependencies and responding to disruptions.</li> <li>A project management approach: define owners, due dates, and next steps; anticipate risks; and keep multiple workstreams moving independently. Comfort tracking action items in GitLab issues and epics or similar tools such as Jira.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to turn information from multiple sources into useful agendas, summaries, and preparation materials. An asynchronous-first approach, with documentation as part of your day-to-day work.</li> <li>Discretion with sensitive information, including organizational changes, performance matters, and incidents, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and backgrounds.</li> <li>Comfort using Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, or similar administrative and expense platforms, and flexibility to support meetings across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, including outside standard hours when needed.</li> <li>Proactive, responsive, ownership-minded executive support with a white-glove approach, a great attitude, and the ability to act without being asked.</li> <li>A strong team player who communicates openly with the executive support team and covers for peers when needed.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI tools (Claude is our standard) to improve administrative work, with the judgment to check outputs for accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s CTO organization, supporting multiple senior engineering leaders (typically two to three members of the engineering leadership team). Together, their priorities span advancing product capabilities, reliability, next-generation architecture, growth of the GitLab business, and engineering hiring. You’ll work with their teams and a globally distributed network of executive business administrators, using asynchronous communication, clear documentation, and shared processes to coordinate work and keep commitments visible as plans change.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
description: Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm. Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden. Dein Aufgabenbereich Startphase (erste Wochen): Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf. Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards. Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse. Im weiteren Verlauf: Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte. Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher. Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete. Das bieten wir dir Strukturierter Einstieg : Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards Mentoring & Coaching : regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt) Skalierbare Perspektive : Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr” Team mit Performance-Kultur : klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse Nichts für dich, wenn… du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst Muss Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH) Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich) Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse Wunsch Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Die Gesellschaft für innovative Personalwirtschaftssysteme mbH ist ein führender Softwarehersteller von integrierten HR Management-Anwendungen für staatliche, öffentliche und soziale Arbeitgeber in Deutschland. KIDICAP® bildet eine moderne Web-APP-Plattform für alle Bereiche des Human Capital Managements und alle Unternehmensgrößen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt rund 200 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit wachsender Tendenz. Analyse von Änderungen im Sozialversicherungsrecht und in den Meldeverfahren sowie deren Umsetzung in Anforderungen, Jira und unseren internen Systemen Erstellung präziser Anforderungsspezifikationen und User Stories, Priorisierung gemeinsam mit dem Scrum-Team und (Mit-)Verantwortung für das Product Backlog Weiterentwicklung des Produkts mit eigenen Ideen, inklusive Neukonzeption gewachsener Komponenten, wo der bestehende Ansatz nicht mehr trägt Sicherstellung von Konformität und Wartung als verlässliche Basis für unsere Kunden Enge Abstimmung mit Kunden als fachliche Ansprechperson Unterstützung der fachlichen Qualitätssicherung sowie Verantwortung für Kommunikation und Dokumentation in deinem Bereich Arbeit mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum, Design Thinking oder Personas Requirements Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du dich gern in komplexe Berechnungs- und Melderegeln einarbeitest und ein Team mitnehmen kannst. title: CX Systems & Automation Lead
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As our CX Systems & Automation Lead, you'll own the systems that power Notion's global support organization. Reporting to the Head of AMER & EMEA Direct Support, you'll administer and evolve our CX tools (Zendesk, Decagon, and Assembled) as Notion scales, and help decide what our stack looks like next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll work closely with CX leadership to shape our systems strategy, then design, build, and ship it yourself. This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Own administration and architecture of our Helpdesk and CX platforms, design and build routing, automations, macros, SLAs, permissions, customizations, and third-party integrations, and set best practices for how they're used - Partner with CX leadership to shape our CX systems strategy and roadmap, then lead delivery from design through implementation, including running system RFPs when needed and advising on the impact of changes on teams, workflows, and customers - Partner with our AI team to configure, maintain, and improve our AI support agents, including knowledge inputs, guardrails, and performance tracking, and help CX leaders decide where automation should and shouldn't handle customer conversations - Own change management for CX systems, from prioritizing requests to sandbox testing, release planning, access controls, data privacy (e.g., GDPR, PII handling), and communicating changes to global teams - Partner with our global (AMER, EMEA, APAC, & Vendor) CX team to be the point of contact for our CX tool stack - Partner with CX leaders to drive tool-related reporting and data visibility - Identify, diagnose, and resolve issues that arise with CX tooling systems - Maintain up-to-date documentation for our CX tools, including key decisions, major changes, and the business reasons behind routing and automation choices SKILLS YOU'LL BRING - You have 7+ years of relevant experience, ideally in SaaS or AI, with deep hands-on administration of an enterprise helpdesk or CRM (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Fin); experience running or migrating between platforms is a plus - You're comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and SQL, have built custom integrations, and have partnered with technical teams to deploy AI agents in a support environment; scripting (JavaScript or Python) or integration tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier) are a plus - You're as comfortable in a strategy discussion as in the admin console, and you've personally built the configurations and integrations you've recommended - You have experience supporting cross-functional programs that relate to CX, operations, engineering, and enablement - You can translate business needs and strategy into technical deliverables and clear roadmaps, and keep leaders and stakeholders aligned on status, milestones, and risks - You have a metrics mindset: you measure success by outcomes and have built dashboards that tell a clear story with KPIs - You have a scaled approach to tool management & implementation - You thrive in ambiguity and can manage technical and administrative work independently as priorities change Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $200,000 per year. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. You map the territory, identify the decision-makers, and architect the outbound strategies required to break into enterprise accounts from scratch. A Continuous Growth Mindset: Modern B2B sales cycles shift rapidly, and legacy sales scripts no longer work on smart e-commerce buyers. You are constantly experimenting with new outreach mediums, testing messaging hooks, and studying the digital retail landscape. When a deal stalls, you don't blame the product, you treat it as a data point to dissect, learn from, and iterate your approach for the next pitch. What We Offer You to Win Transparent & Uncapped Compensation: A competitive base salary of €60k - €85k (geo-bracketed to your location) + an uncapped Variable Compensation Plan (VCP) where you are rewarded heavily for target overachievement. True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business. Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person. Modern Sales Stack & Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home. Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays. The Non-Negotiables Native/Fluent German & Professional English: You will be closing deals in German; you will be collaborating with the global team in English. Proven B2B SaaS Closing Record: You have spent at least 3+ years managing full-cycle sales cycles (from cold outreach to signed contract) directly within the DACH retail, e-commerce, or digital marketing spaces. Outbound Execution: You do not wait for inbound marketing leads. You know how to multi-thread accounts and hunt your own pipeline. Pennylane accélère fortement le développement de ses activités Financial Services / Banking . Pour accompagner cette croissance et sécuriser la trajectoire financière de cette activité stratégique, nous recrutons un·e FP&A Analyst dédié·e aux Financial Services . Au sein de l’équipe FP&A, tu seras le point de référence financier du périmètre. Tu travailleras au croisement des équipes Finance, Financial Services, Strategy, Risk et Compliance , dans un environnement en forte croissance et soumis à des enjeux réglementaires spécifiques. Tes missions Piloter la performance Financial Services Construire, maintenir et challenger le modèle financier du périmètre Financial Services. Produire une lecture claire de la performance à destination des équipes opérationnelles et de la Finance. Maîtriser les revenus, les coûts et la marge Modéliser les différentes composantes du chiffre d’affaires : acquisition clients, nombre de comptes, mix produit, pricing. Reconstituer et piloter la structure de coûts à mesure que le périmètre est internalisé et se développe. Analyser les coûts directs, indirects, mutualisés, réglementaires, récurrents et exceptionnels. Suivre les indicateurs de marge et construire les analyses de rentabilité pertinentes par produit, partenaire ou segment. Accompagner la croissance et les décisions stratégiques Évaluer la faisabilité financière des objectifs de croissance et le niveau de ressources nécessaire pour les atteindre. Construire des scénarios et analyses de sensibilité sur les principaux leviers et risques du Business Plan. Préparer les contributions Financial Services aux cycles de Budget et de Reforecast. Challenger les hypothèses des équipes et contribuer aux arbitrages d’investissement. Construire un pilotage adapté à une activité régulée Intégrer dans les modèles les coûts partenaires, les contraintes réglementaires et les risques opérationnels. Travailler avec les équipes Risk et Compliance pour traduire les enjeux réglementaires en impacts financiers. Faire évoluer les indicateurs, reportings et processus à mesure que l’activité gagne en maturité. Fiabiliser et automatiser les analyses, en lien avec les outils FP&A et les équipes Data. L’impact attendu Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras directement à : sécuriser un Business Plan ambitieux grâce à des hypothèses robustes et régulièrement challengées ; améliorer la visibilité sur les revenus, les coûts, la marge et les principaux risques ; donner aux équipes et aux dirigeants une information financière fiable et actionnable ; structurer les réflexes et les outils FP&A propres à une activité Banking ; assurer une communication lean avec les équipes opérationnelles Financial Services. Ton profil Tu as une expérience solide de 5 ans minimum en FP&A, Transaction Services, audit, conseil financier, contrôle de gestion ou finance stratégique . Tu maîtrises la modélisation financière, les cycles Budget / Forecast et l’analyse des écarts. Tu sais transformer des données complexes en conclusions simples, structurées et orientées décision. Tu fais preuve d’une grande rigueur, tout en gardant une forte compréhension des enjeux business. Tu es à l’aise pour travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés et challenger de manière constructive. Tu as un excellent niveau sur Excel ou Google Sheets ; une expérience d’un EPM tel que Pigment est un plus. Tu communiques avec clarté, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, en français et en anglais. Une expérience dans la banque, la fintech, les paiements ou un environnement régulé est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable si tu démontres une forte capacité d’apprentissage. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Prendre en charge le pilotage financier d’une activité stratégique en très forte croissance. Construire les modèles, indicateurs et processus de référence d’un périmètre encore en structuration. Travailler sur des problématiques qui combinent finance, stratégie, opérations et réglementation. Unser Team unterstützt Landwirte bei betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen, von Hofübergaben bis hin zur Einführung neuer Geschäftsmodelle wie der Direktvermarktung. In Ihrer Rolle werden Sie Teil unseres kleinen, dynamischen Teams und tragen zur Erstellung und Optimierung von Inhalten bei, die unsere Kunden über aktuelle Trends und innovative Lösungen in der Landwirtschaft informieren. Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren Experten zusammen und erhalten wertvolle Einblicke in die Herausforderungen und Chancen der modernen Agrarwirtschaft. Wenn Sie Leidenschaft für die Landwirtschaft und Talent im Schreiben von ansprechenden Inhalten mitbringen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie in unserem Team willkommen zu heißen. Aufgaben Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Inhalten für die Webseite und andere Kommunikationskanäle in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Beratungsteam. Recherche von aktuellen Trends und Entwicklungen in der landwirtschaftlichen Beratung zur Erstellung relevanter und ansprechender Inhalte. Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen und anderen Materialien für Kundenbesprechungen und interne Schulungen. Erstellung und Pflege von Beiträgen für soziale Medien, um das Engagement der Zielgruppe zu steigern und die Markenbekanntheit zu fördern. Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Content-Marketing-Kampagnen zur Förderung der Dienstleistungen von Claudius Wurth Agrarberatung. Qualifikation Laufendes Studium im Bereich Agrarwissenschaften Erste Erfahrungen in der Content-Erstellung und Interesse an landwirtschaftlichen Themen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Content-Management-Systemen. Selbständige Arbeitsweise, Zuverlässigkeit und Kreativität. Benefits Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Raum für Eigeninitiative Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Ein motiviertes und kollegiales Team Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Cyber Essentials Plus Lead Assessor (IASME licensed)
description: Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm and an IASME licensed Certification Body for Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus. We are adding experienced Cyber Essentials Plus Lead Assessors to our associate panel to lead UK client assessments from start to finish. This is an associate contractor role. Work is offered assessment by assessment, with no guaranteed volume. Each assignment is covered by a written statement of work that sets out the scope, timetable, location and fee before you accept it. Tasks Lead Cyber Essentials Plus assessments from scoping to certificate decision, in line with the current IASME and NCSC test specification. Check the Cyber Essentials self assessment and confirm the Cyber Essentials Plus scope is correct before testing starts. Work out the device sample and plan testing of user devices, internet gateways, cloud services and public facing services. Carry out remote and onsite testing, authenticated vulnerability scans and evidence checks. Record findings clearly, agree fixes with the client and manage retesting within the permitted timescale. Write complete assessment records and clear client reports. Review the work of other assessors on the panel before results are submitted, and give them practical feedback. Handle the larger and more complex assessments, such as multi site organisations and mixed Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile estates. Work through Intelance accounts, systems and quality checks, and protect all client information. Tell us about any conflict of interest before you accept an assignment. Requirements Essential Current IASME appointment as a Cyber Essentials Assessor and a Cyber Essentials Plus Assessor. We will check this with IASME. At least two years of delivering Cyber Essentials Plus assessments, with 20 or more completed in the last 12 months. Experience reviewing or signing off other assessors' work, or acting as Lead Assessor for a Certification Body. Based in the UK and able to attend client sites in the UK when an assessment needs it. Strong hands on knowledge of Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, firewalls, cloud services, multi factor authentication and vulnerability scanning. Able to explain findings in plain English to business owners and IT teams. Professional Indemnity and Public Liability insurance of at least £1m each before any client work starts. Two recent references for Cyber Essentials Plus work. Useful CISSP, CISM, CREST, OSCP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or another qualification accepted on the IASME assessor route. Experience with Qualys, Tenable Nessus or a similar approved scanning tool. IASME Cyber Assurance assessor status. Benefits Day rate of £375 to £550, or a fixed fee for each assessment agreed before you accept the work. A steady flow of scoped assessments from an established Certification Body, with no sales work for you to do. Remote preparation and reporting, with site visits only when the assessment needs them. Access to Intelance templates, scanning capability, secure collaboration tools and quality review. A clear route to a trusted associate role and more senior assurance work across ISO 27001 and IASME Cyber Assurance. You choose which assignments you accept. Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for IASME assessor evidence and two references. Please do not send any client material. value="3">Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning, including remote state, workspaces, and module design.</li> <li value="4">Ability to write scripts and automation in Python, Sales, and Professional Services on questions, issues, roadmaps, and escalations.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain Customer Success Plans with assigned customers, defining critical goals and key and customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Stay current on GitLab releases and new features, and proactively provide insights and recommendations on how customers can use them to achieve their objectives.</li> <li value="9">Identify and recommend training and services opportunities that support customer enablement and long-term success.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Proven experience in customer success, post-sales, or professional services roles with a focus on driving adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes.</li> <li value="2">Practical understanding of Git, common branching strategies, and the software development lifecycle, including continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices.</li> <li value="3">Ability to act as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders, partnering with customers to define, prioritize, and achieve their desired outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Strong communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication, effective presentations, and the ability to explain technical topics to varied audiences.</li> <li value="5">Demonstrated project management capabilities, including organizing work, managing escalations, and coordinating across internal teams such as Support, Product Management, Sales, and Services.</li> <li value="6">Analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret customer data, identify risks or opportunities, and recommend actionable next steps.</li> <li value="7">Comfort working both independently and as part of a distributed team, with attention to detail and alignment to GitLab’s values.</li> <li value="8">Openness to travel as needed and to apply transferable skills from related roles or industries in support of customer success and technical enablement.</li> <li value="8">Fluent French</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Customer Success Architect team focuses on hands-on technical title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Application Development Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Senior Manager, Enterprise Application Development Engineering, you’ll lead the team that builds and runs GitLab’s internal applications. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI, and lead a team growing to seven engineers across the US, EMEA and India. The work is highly cross-functional: your partners span go-to-market, Finance, People, R&D, Data & Insights and more, often with competing priorities.</p> <p>This is a leadership role, not a hands-on coding role. You’ll own the technical direction and the team’s standards and working practices, and spend most of your time developing engineers and making sure the team delivers at pace while holding a very high bar for quality. Hiring will be a big focus early on as the team grows.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team.</strong> Coach and grow engineers across time zones, with clear expectations, useful feedback and async practices that hold up, and hire well as the team grows.</li> <li><strong>Own the technical direction and quality bar.</strong> This is an AI-native team: agents write most of the code, and engineers set the direction and own the result. You’ll review designs and architecture, set the standards for testing, code review, CI/CD and releases, and be accountable for everything the team ships meeting a high bar for quality, however much of it AI wrote.</li> <li><strong>Shape what gets built.</strong> Each application has a named business owner who owns the outcome; you own how it’s built and run. Decide with them whether to build, buy, configure or extend, weighing cost, expected return and long-term ownership.</li> <li><strong>Manage delivery across the portfolio.</strong> Turn priorities into achievable plans, make trade-offs visible and balance new work with maintenance and support.</li> <li><strong>Work as one team with AI Engineering.</strong> Application development and AI engineering are one Enterprise AI team with different focus areas. Decide together whether a problem needs an app, an agent or a skill.</li> <li><strong>Protect sensitive data.</strong> Several applications hold people and financial data. Work with Security, Privacy and Legal on access, data protection reviews and works council requirements.</li> <li><strong>Own each application for its whole life.</strong> Make sure each one has an owner, monitoring, support and a known cost to run, and consolidate or retire it when it stops earning its keep.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters.</strong> Track idea-to-production time, user satisfaction (CSAT) and cost to run against value.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Several years managing software engineering teams, including senior engineers, with a record of hiring and developing people.</li> <li>A background building and running production software across the stack, including data and integrations, so you can engage credibly with the technical detail.</li> <li>Sound engineering and product judgment: you know when an approach needs to change and where custom software is justified.</li> <li>Experience leading a distributed team across time zones in a highly cross-functional, remote and asynchronous setting.</li> <li>Experience leading AI-native development, where agents write most of the code, and the judgment to keep quality high as output grows.</li> <li>Strong communication with technical and non-technical partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading a portfolio of internal business applications.</li> <li>Experience with GitLab, CI/CD and data platforms such as Snowflake.</li> <li>Experience with applications that handle sensitive people or financial data.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Enterprise Application Development sits within Enterprise AI in GitLab’s Enterprise Technology & AI organization. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. You'll also guide migrations from other systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed deployments, and help customers make practical decisions that improve reliability, security, and day-to-day workflows.</p> <p>In this role, you'll work closely with customers and GitLab's product and engineering teams to drive customer success and share feedback that improves GitLab and how we deliver services. You'll manage multiple projects at once, mentor other Professional Services Engineers, and help streamline how we deliver consistent outcomes in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab installations and reference architectures using tools like Terraform and Ansible across major cloud providers</li> <li>Leading migrations to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, and turning customer feedback into actionable improvements for GitLab's product and engineering teams</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deliver GitLab Professional Services engagements, including installation, migration, training, and advisory services across GitLab capabilities.</li> <li>Plan and execute source systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, helping customers adopt secure, reliable workflows.</li> <li>Partner with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to improve delivery consistency, remove friction, and continuously refine delivery processes.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor for customers, translating goals and constraints into practical implementation plans and clear next steps.</li> <li>Interface with GitLab's product and engineering teams to unblock customer outcomes and share feedback that helps improve GitLab features and services.</li> <li>Mentor Associate and Intermediate Professional Services Engineers, providing technical guidance, helping remove blockers, and supporting increased autonomy.</li> <li>Manage and deliver multiple customer engagements at once, either as the primary engineer or as a lead providing oversight and direction to other engineers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional exposure with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.</li> <li>Professional exposure with two or more cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.</li> <li><strong>This role has a location requirement - Charlotte, NC or nearby - on site at the Customer location in Charlotte, 5 days a week.</strong></li> <li>Experience using, deploying, or configuring GitLab, including a solid understanding of Git and source control workflows.</li> <li>Experience delivering customer-facing services such as installation, migration, training, and advisory engagements across GitLab's feature set.</li> <li>Proven ability to independently manage one or more projects and to lead and provide direction to other Professional Services Engineers on complex engagements.</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English, written and verbal, with the ability to provide clear status updates and build consensus with peers and customers in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to take a solution-oriented approach by identifying root causes, proposing options and tradeoffs, and driving issues to resolution while balancing multiple customer engagements in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fully remote organization by communicating clearly in writing, documenting decisions, collaborating asynchronously across time zones, and working in ways consistent with GitLab's values.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Senior Professional Services Engineers are part of GitLab's Professional Services team. We partner closely with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to deliver consistent outcomes, and we work with GitLab's product and engineering teams to share customer feedback and improve GitLab.
