Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="h.4x3v2cmvixi0">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Marketing organization, you’ll support the Vice President (VP) of Growth Marketing and the VP of Product and Technical Marketing, reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll join leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders, their teams, and the other executive support partners, and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs four to six weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion. You’ll move quickly, build AI-powered workflows to automate recurring work, and be a warm, approachable partner to the people on both leaders’ teams.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Protect focus time, recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.</li> <li>Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.</li> <li>Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.</li> <li>Partner with senior directors and team leads across both organizations, helping when it moves the leaders’ priorities and bringing the leaders in when it matters.</li> <li>Support team connection by remembering milestones and getting notes, gifts, or flowers out quickly.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.</li> <li>Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.</li> <li>Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects.</li> <li>Build and maintain artificial intelligence (AI) workflows, with Claude as our standard, to automate research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone.</li> <li>Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-growing company, ideally SaaS or AI-forward, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>A bias for action and ownership: you move from ask to done quickly, act independently within agreed priorities, and communicate progress proactively, with an organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities.</li> <li>Comfort figuring things out on your own in a fast-changing environment with limited resources.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.</li> <li>Project management skills, including building work-back plans, following up with owners, and keeping multiple workstreams moving with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Experience coordinating international travel and team events from start to finish, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements through completion.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics.</li> <li>Clear, approachable communication across functions and levels, and a track record of building trust with executives, peers, and other executive support partners.</li> <li>Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.</li> <li>Experience in a remote, asynchronous environment where documentation and written communication are central.</li> <li>Flexibility to support meetings across time zones outside standard hours on occasion, with up to quarterly travel for team meetings and all-hands (about four trips a year, three to four days each).</li> <li>Located in the US or Canada, with strong overlap with Pacific time.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders who together lead about 120 people in a fast-moving, AI-forward organization. Their teams work closely together on campaigns, launches, and events. You’ll work alongside a globally distributed group of executive support professionals who collaborate asynchronously through clear documentation and shared processes. The focus is dependable support: keeping priorities clear, coordinating global travel and events, and ensuring commitments are completed and communicated as plans change.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Working Student AI Engineer – LLMs, RAG & AI Agents
description: IMPORTANT Application note Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you. About AgentixLake AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities. Your role Build AI application components that are ready to be tested, deployed and maintained. You will take ownership of defined engineering work within our generative AI projects, collaborating with colleagues on implementation, review and operational quality. Our team builds enterprise AI solutions that connect models with useful data and tools. Your work may contribute to document intelligence, knowledge assistants, governed analytics or AI agents that support engineering and operational workflows. What you will do Develop Python services and integrations connecting language models to enterprise data, APIs and tools. Implement document ingestion, chunking, embeddings and retrieval, with source references that users can inspect. Build structured extraction and validation workflows for complex documents and downstream business systems. Implement defined agent steps, including tool calls, permission checks, error handling and human approval. Maintain evaluation cases and compare retrieval quality, answer usefulness, latency and cost as the application changes. Contribute automated tests, deployment configuration, logging and documentation through reviewed pull requests. What you bring Current university enrolment in computer science, AI, data science or a related technical discipline. Strong practical Python skills and evidence of software you have delivered for actual users, including responsibility for testing and deployment. Hands-on experience with an LLM application involving retrieval, tool use or structured outputs, and the ability to explain its limitations. Comfort working with APIs, JSON, Git and code review, and taking a defined task from an agreed requirement to a maintainable implementation. Clear English communication and an evidence-based approach to debugging and evaluating system behaviour. Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, FastAPI, Docker, vector databases or self-hosted models is valuable. We value sound implementation decisions more than the number of frameworks on your CV. What you can expect You will contribute to real delivery work with direct access to experienced engineers and the founders. Expect clear ownership, thoughtful code review and a part-time scope planned around your studies. How to apply Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Explain one AI application you built, your individual contribution, how you evaluated it and what you improved after testing. An anonymised description is welcome; please do not share confidential client material. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. Wir legen viel Wert auf strategische Beratung erstklassige operative Ausführung. Das heißt, Du findest hier keine Massenabfertigung sondern kannst Dir wirklich Zeit nehmen, um das Meiste aus Deinen Kunden rauszuholen. Aufgaben Als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bist du dafür verantwortlich, die besten Ergebnisse für Deine Kunden zu erfüllen - alleine und gemeinsam im Zweier-Projektteam. Du übernimmst ein Portfolio mit bestehenden E-Commerce Kunden (4-6 stellige monatliche Budgets) und betreust diese operativ und auch strategisch bei der Weiterentwicklung. Du übernimmst dabei das Aufsetzen, die Steuerung, Messung und Optimierung der Google Ads (& Microsoft Ads) Kampagnen und optimalerweise auch Web Analytics Maßnahmen und sorgst somit maßgeblich für den Erfolg des Kunden. Du konzipierst und planst eigenständig hochprofitable Performance-Marketing-Strategien: Dabei nutzt du deine Kenntnisse von Google Search / Shopping / PMAX/ Demand Gen / YouTube / Display und sorgst somit für die effiziente Steigerung der Umsätze deiner Kunden. Du übernimmst die Analyse und Auswertung der Kampagnen und kannst anhand der Reportings Empfehlungen ableiten. Du beobachtest Marktentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Chancen zum weiteren Ausbau der Performance-Aktivitäten. Du analysierst die Unternehmensstruktur Deiner Kunden, verstehst die wirtschaftlich relevanten Kennzahlen und bildest darauf aufbauend performance-orientierte Lösungen ab. Es ist wichtig, dass du eigenständig arbeiten kannst, dir die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Kunden Spaß macht und du gerne ins Detail gehst. Erfahrener Umgang mit fünf- bis sechsstelligen Budgets bei Google Ads. Zusätzlich praktische Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center, Google Analytics. Bonus wäre Erfahrung mit Looker Studio und dem Google Tag Manager. Praktische Erfahrung im eigenständigen Kundenkontakt und Kundenentwicklung durch vorherige Positionen. Kundenorientierte, selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsorientierung. Die Analyse und Auswertung von Daten gehört zu Deinen größten Stärken. Du wertest Deine Kampagnen aus und triffst auf Basis Deiner Analyse die nächste Entscheidung. Dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten, Deine souveräne Art sowie starke Kommunikations Skills zeichnen Dich aus und machen Dich unheimlich erfolgreich im Kundenkontakt/ in der Kundenbetreuung. Steile Lernkurve durch Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im SEA und Web Analytics und jährlicher Besuch von Fachmessen oder Schulungen. Lange Kundenbindung ermöglicht es, sich sehr tief mit unseren Kunden und ihren Prozessen auseinander zu setzen, um gemeinsam mit den Kunden zu wachsen. Karriereperspektiven und die Möglichkeit an der Gestaltung der Agenturprozesse teilzuhaben. Flache Hierarchien: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sergej, dem Geschäftsführer und Aufstiegschancen. Zugriff auf unser sehr umfangreiches internes Wissens Wiki. Quartalsweise mehrtätige Meetings mit dem ganzen Team für gemeinsames Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten. Ausstattung mit Apple MacBook, großem Bildschirm und hochwertigen Peripheriegeräte. Home Office (innerhalb Deutschlands) mit Option ins Büro in Hamburg zu kommen. title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Contractor (AMER)

Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. You'll join a collaborative group that coordinates interview logistics, manages candidate flow in our applicant tracking system, and supports offer and onboarding handoffs so candidates and hiring teams have a clear, organized experience at every stage. The team works asynchronously across time zones, using GitLab and shared documentation to stay aligned while handling high-volume hiring. Our focus is on refining processes, maintaining accurate data, and acting as brand ambassadors for GitLab's values in every candidate interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Director Growth Marketing
description: Welcome to Glow25! At Glow25 , we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty. For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on. We look forward to getting to know you. These are our current challenges and future goals: We are looking for a Director Growth Marketing to take ownership of Glow25's growth engine. At the core of this role is hands-on, end-to-end full-funnel marketing — someone who can build and run that engine personally, scale the brand internationally, and turn customer lifetime value into a durable competitive advantage. This is where we need your support: Own full-funnel marketing end-to-en. From top-of-funnel awareness through acquisition, conversion and retention - as the primary engine for scaling Glow25 internationally. Orchestrate all marketing channel; paid, organic, social, CRM and affiliate to ensure a consistently high ROAS across the funnel. Drive growth of eCommerce & marketplaces as a key revenue channel. Leverage customer lifetime value by building out CRM, subscription and loyalty programs that deepen retention and repeat purchase. Acquire market share in the collagen category and adjacent categories through sharp positioning and disciplined execution. Create differentiated brand positioning versus competitors, sharpening how Glow25 shows up against the broader collagen and wellness set. You have the following experience: Hands-on, full-funnel marketing expertise, this is the core of the role, with a demonstrated track record of continuously improving conversion rates. D2C full-funnel marketing experience gained in a start-up and/or scale-up environment. An analytical, tech-driven marketing profile, comfortable setting up AI-driven campaign workflows and acting on data. A track record of managing and delivering against ambitious growth targets. Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial setup - fast-paced, dynamic and agile. Fluent English is a must; German on top would be ideal. Ideally, you also bring: Experience leading the internationalization of a D2C brand. Experience supporting a D2C brand's transition into an omnichannel brand. That's something you can look forward to: Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking. Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace. Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you. Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because. Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers. Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything. Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too! Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings. Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%. Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms. Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day. Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Why Glow25? You'll take the growth engine of one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands and shape its next chapter — with real ownership, a data-rich environment, and the mandate to build a full-funnel marketing organization from a position of scale rather than zero. title: INTESCIA - Ingénieur systèmes et réseaux (H/F) - CDD 6 mois
description: Ingénieur systèmes et réseaux (H/F) CDD - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. En tant qu’Ingénieur Systèmes & Réseaux, vous rejoignez une équipe d’experts et jouez un rôle clé dans la conception, l’évolution et la sécurisation de nos infrastructures IT. Vous participez activement à plusieurs projets structurants, notamment la modernisation de notre architecture d’identité Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, le déploiement de Microsoft Intune pour la gestion de nos équipements Windows, macOS et iOS, ainsi que la migration de VMware vers Proxmox. Vous contribuez également à l’évolution de nos infrastructures réseau et cloud, en veillant à garantir la performance, la disponibilité et la sécurité de nos environnements techniques. Dans le cadre de notre mission, nous recherchons une personne capable de nous venir en renfort sur les 6 prochains mois, avec pour objectif de réaliser les missions suivantes (liste non exhaustive) : Administrer, maintenir et faire évoluer les infrastructures systèmes et réseaux du groupe. Participer à la modernisation de notre architecture d'identité Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, notamment la synchronisation des identités et la mise en place des configurations hybrides. Déployer et administrer Microsoft Intune pour l'enrôlement et la gestion des équipements Windows, macOS et iOS (iPhone). Mettre en place et maintenir les profils de configuration, les stratégies de sécurité et de conformité des équipements, ainsi que les déploiements applicatifs. Concevoir, administrer et maintenir les infrastructures de virtualisation Proxmox VE. Participer activement à la migration de VMware vers Proxmox, en collaboration avec nos partenaires technologiques. Administrer les environnements Linux et Windows Server et assurer leur maintien en condition opérationnelle. Administrer et faire évoluer les infrastructures réseau : VLAN, switching, routage, segmentation et interconnexions entre sites. Administrer les pare-feu Fortinet, les VPN inter-sites et les règles de sécurité réseau. Mettre en œuvre et maintenir les solutions de sauvegarde, de restauration et de continuité de service. Participer à l'administration et au maintien en condition opérationnelle des ressources AWS, ainsi qu'à leur intégration dans l'infrastructure existante. Assurer la supervision des infrastructures, analyser les incidents et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires. Contribuer à la sécurisation des systèmes et des réseaux, à l'amélioration continue et à la documentation technique. La rémunération fixe sur ce poste est de 48K€ annuelle. Le profil que nous recherchons : Nous recherchons un profil avec minimum 5 années d’expérience, mais aussi : Expérience confirmée en administration systèmes et réseaux en environnement de production. Expérience sur Microsoft Entra ID, la synchronisation Active Directory / Entra, les environnements hybrides et Microsoft Intune (Windows, macOS et iOS). Expérience en virtualisation Proxmox VE et participation à des projets de migration depuis VMware. Maîtrise de l'administration réseau et des pare-feu Fortinet. Expérience en administration Windows Server et Linux, gestion des sauvegardes et supervision des infrastructures. Connaissance des outils de gestion de parc informatique et de ticketing, notamment GLPI. Pratique régulière d'AWS appréciée. Capacité à rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire et à jour. Ce que nous vous offrons : Poste basé à : Toulouse / Carquefou / Issy-les-Moulineaux. Type de contrat : CDD de 6 mois Rémunération fixe Horaires de travail : 09h00 - 17h00 Carte tickets restaurants Option de télétravail ou flexibilité pour une meilleure organisation de votre quotidien Un cadre de travail responsabilisant, formateur et propice à l’épanouissement Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location. Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. Nice to have: experience selling services. Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. What We Offer: Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. The Experience: Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. title: Channel Marketing Manager
description: About Nextcloud At Nextcloud we help our users achieve a safe home for all their data. Secure, under your control and developed in an open, transparent and trustworthy way. Our team of 170 is distributed in 30 countries worldwide. We work remotely and our work culture is shaped by mutual trust, enthusiasm and a strong belief in the principles of open source. We are looking for a Channel Marketing Manager who will plan and run marketing activities that help Nextcloud grow through its channel partner ecosystem. You will work closely with the sales and marketing teams to activate partners such as resellers and service providers, develop partner campaigns, and create enablement resources that increase engagement. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London (Hybrid) / UK Remote | 💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐Our Design team</strong></p> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up over half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, engineering and data to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p><strong>We design for the "magic moments"</strong></p> <p>We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product <em>is</em> our personality. We blend research, empathy, data and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future — and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.</p> <p><strong>🌱 About Growth</strong></p> <p>Our Growth collective is focused on helping more people discover Monzo, understand what makes us different, and find the products that can make money work better for them.</p> <p>For this role, you’ll have a particular focus on our <strong>web experiences</strong>, helping us rethink how people discover, explore and choose Monzo before they ever open the app. You’ll combine strong visual and interaction design with a data-informed mindset, using experimentation and customer insight to understand what works and continuously improve the experience.</p> <p>You don’t need to have worked in a dedicated Growth team before. We’re interested in designers who are curious about customer behaviour, comfortable using data to inform their decisions, and excited by the opportunity to apply exceptional craft to high-impact customer journeys.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading the design of high-quality web experiences that help new and existing customers discover the value Monzo can bring to their financial lives.</li> <li>Using quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, understand customer behaviour and make informed design decisions.</li> <li>Turning customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, designing experiments and using what you learn to shape what we do next.</li> <li>Bringing exceptional visual and interaction craft to our web experiences, creating work that feels unmistakably Monzo while driving meaningful customer and commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Tackling complex and ambiguous design challenges, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to create simple, effective experiences.</li> <li>Defining compelling product visions and direction, helping teams think beyond individual experiments towards a coherent long-term customer experience.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Research throughout the design process, bringing people together around customer problems and opportunities.</li> <li>Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.</li> <li>Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of designing <strong>high-quality web experiences</strong>, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.</li> <li>You’re comfortable using <strong>data to inform your design decisions</strong>, partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.</li> <li>You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.</li> <li>You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.</li> <li>You can balance speed and experimentation with a high bar for craft, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest in creating an exceptional final experience.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who can bring together Product, Engineering, Data, Research and other partners around complex customer problems.</li> <li>You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity and direction when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.</li> <li>You’re comfortable thinking beyond an individual screen or experiment, connecting work across journeys and helping shape a longer-term vision.</li> <li>You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through mentoring, feedback and sharing your expertise.</li> <li>You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and the opportunity to help more people discover the value of Monzo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.<br>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.<br>✅ We can sponsor your visa.<br>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).<br>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.<br>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br>➕ Plus lots more!</p> <p>🌈 <strong>The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30-minute call with our Recruiter, Tom</li> <li>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team</li> <li>2 x 45-minute interviews covering Teamwork and Impact</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1<br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Fachredakteur Steuerrecht (m/w/d) - Content & SEO
description: Wer wir sind Seit 16 Jahren betreuen wir als digitale Steuerkanzlei Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland, vor allem E-Commerce, vemögensverwaltende GmbH und KMU. Wir sprechen Steuerrecht genauso fließend wie Software und machen Steuerberatung mit eigenen Lösungen einfacher. Wir sind inhabergeführt, unabhängig und ohne Investoren. Unser Ziel: Deutschlands beste digitale Steuerkanzlei zu werden. Damit Unternehmer das auch verstehen, suchen wir dich. Deine Vision bei uns Wir wollen die Steuerkanzlei sein, der Unternehmer im Netz am meisten vertrauen. Nicht durch Werbung, sondern durch Inhalte, die wirklich helfen. Du baust diese Wissensplattform mit auf. Deine Texte werden zur ersten Anlaufstelle, wenn jemand eine Holding gründen, eine Trading GmbH verstehen oder seinen Jahresabschluss einordnen will. Und danach? Eine Wissensplattform ist nie ganz fertig, aber wir haben schon viele Ideen, wie es weitergeht. Du wächst mit und gestaltest mit, welche Formate und Projekte als Nächstes kommen. Deine Aufgaben Neue Blogartikel nach SEO/GEO-Standards zu Steuerthemen schreiben (Keyword-Beispiele: holding gründen kosten, jahresabschluss bundesanzeiger, gmbh steuern) Bestehende Blogartikel und Landingpages inhaltlich und sprachlich verbessern Fachliche Texte für Landingpages: Leistungsbeschreibungen, FAQs, Rechenbeispiele Skripte schreiben für YouTube-Videos und Social-Media-Clips Fachliche Prüfung von Texten und Freigabe Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing-Manager (SEO, Themenplanung) Texte mit Persönlichkeit: Du schreibst selbst und nicht per KI-Knopfdruck. Uns sind Texte wichtig, die menschlich klingen und Erfahrung zeigen. So könnte deine Woche aussehen: Du schreibst zwei neue Blogartikel, überarbeitest ein YouTube-Skript eines Kollegen und optimierst Texte von drei bereits vorhandenen Landingpages. Das bringst du mit Du bist Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsjurist (Schwerpunkt Steuerrecht) oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Texten, Content oder Blogs Spaß am Schreiben und daran, Komplexes einfach zu erklären Sicheres Deutsch: Du schreibst klar, verständlich und grundsätzlich fehlerfrei. Selbstständiges Arbeiten: Du organisierst dich remote gut selbst und hältst Termine ein. Neugier auf Steuerthemen: Du verfolgst Gesetzesänderungen und hast Lust, sie verständlich aufzubereiten. Das bieten wir Rahmenbedingungen, die passen: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Voll- oder Teilzeit ohne Kernarbeitszeit, High-Tech-Homeoffice-Setup, individuelle Arbeitszeitgestaltung und 30 Tage Urlaub ohne Urlaubssperre. 100 % Homeoffice: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und bist trotzdem eng in die fachlichen und persönlichen Strukturen des Teams eingebunden, das sich gegenseitig stark unterstützt. Kein Fristendruck, keine Buchhaltung, keine Jahresabschlüsse, Steuererklärungen Sichtbarkeit: deine Texte und Videos erreichen tausende Unternehmer Direkter Draht zu unseren Steuerberatern und Spezialisten für Trading, E-Commerce und GmbH, du bleibst fachlich am Puls. Tolles Team: Du arbeitest mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die ihr Wissen gern teilen und sich gegenseitig unterstützen. Auch remote sind wir ein Team: Jedes Jahr gibt es ein Sommerfest, ein Winterfest und ein eigenes Event in Deinem Team. Dein Benefit is nicht dabei? Frag uns gerne an! Noch mehr Eindrücke von uns und unserer Unternehmenskultur erhältst Du auf unserer Karriereseite und auf www.kununu.com/de/steueragenten-de. Bereit für diese etwas andere Stelle? title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Meta Ads & Performance Marketing
description: Über die Horn Druck & Verlag KG Die Horn Druck & Verlag KG ist ein traditionsreiches, seit 1986 bestehendes Unternehmen mit Fokussierung auf die Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche. Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im professionellen Meta-Kampagnenmanagement. Sehr tiefgehende Kenntnisse des Meta Ads Managers und seiner vielfältigen Funktionen. Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit der Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung größerer und komplexerer Kampagnen. Fundiertes Wissen in Zielgruppenstrategie, Retargeting, Lookalike Audiences und Conversion-Optimierung. Sicherer Umgang mit Meta Pixel, Conversion API, Events Manager und Tracking. Sehr gutes Verständnis relevanter Performance-Kennzahlen und deren Interpretation. Erfahrung mit Leadgenerierung, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels. Kreatives Gespür für erfolgreiche Anzeigenmotive, Werbebotschaften und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Selbstständige, strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise. Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und an der Entwicklung erfolgreicher Marketingstrategien. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be working in a fast moving environment, building and iterating on our financial crime defensive capabilities to ensure we keep Monzo and our customers safe.</p> <p>Our financial crime team has a large impact on Monzo’s bottom line as fraud and scams are usually some of the largest cost line items in a bank's P&L. We have a major influence on the overall customer experience and it’s our duty to keep our customers safe. The work we do results in directly measurable customer or company benefit, which is incredibly satisfying.</p> <p>Our Machine Learning Scientists work on a range of problems within the different financial crime areas ranging from fraud detection and prevention, transaction monitoring for different types of suspicious activity through to customer risk assessment and operational tooling.</p> <h1>What you’ll be working on:</h1> <p>A Lead Machine Learning Scientist at Monzo is a technical Individual Contributor (IC) leadership position. You’ll also be a technical leader within the Machine Learning discipline, helping to steer technical work and drive up standards.</p> <p>This will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Working with stakeholders across the organization to identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities to tackle Financial Crime and Fraud with Machine Learning.</li> <li>Leading the design and development of advanced real time Machine Learning models, for example exploring how neural network, graph-based, and sequence-based architectures can drive improvements in detection of financial crime.</li> <li>Providing technical leadership to drive up levels of technical expertise and best practice across the Machine Learning discipline, leading by example and mentoring others.</li> <li>Working closely with our MLOps team to steer the ongoing development of tools to enable rapid iteration of models and optimisations of the full ML model lifecycle.</li> </ul> <h1>You should apply if:</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping deep learning, graph-based, and/or sequence-based ML architectures to production and delivering business impact</li> <li>You're impact driven and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>Reducing financial crime and protecting customers with data driven strategies sounds exciting to you</li> <li>You have extensive experience writing production Python code and a strong command of SQL. You are comfortable using them every day, and keen to learn <a href="https://go.dev/">Go lang</a> which is used in many of our backend microservices</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working with financial crime and in regulated institutions</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process:</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.</li> <li>Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.</li> <li>Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics.</li> <li>Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs.</li> <li>Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor.</li> <li>Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1>You should apply if</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company.</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact.</li> <li>You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity.</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day.</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions.</li> <li>You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain.</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas.</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability.</li> <li>You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use.</li> <li>You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.</li> <li>Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.</li> <li>Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.</li> <li>Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.</li> <li>Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you</h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: SRE Platform Manager
description: Who we are Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role At Yubo, Platform Engineering plays a key role in keeping our product reliable and scalable for millions of users, while supporting new technical challenges, including AI. We're looking for an SRE Platform Manager to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael, our Platform Engineering Director. You'll lead 6 experienced DevOps/SRE and Backend Platform Engineers , including Staff Engineers and an Infrastructure Tech Lead. Your mission? Ensure platform reliability, improve delivery performance, and help your team grow while preserving their technical autonomy. You'll also contribute to building the infrastructure needed to deploy AI agents in production, working closely with Security and AI Enablement. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong hands-on SRE/DevOps experience with people leadership , and enjoys balancing technical challenges, operational excellence, and team development. Your responsibilities Lead and develop a team of 6 DevOps/SRE and Backend Platform Engineers Own platform reliability (SLOs, SLIs, monitoring, incident management and on-call) Partner with Staff Engineers to turn technical decisions into actionable plans Drive the infrastructure needed to deploy AI agents in production alongside Security and AI Enablement Monitor cloud costs and drive optimization initiatives Track DORA metrics to improve delivery performance and team efficiency Balance operational needs, technical improvements, and strategic initiatives Foster collaboration across Backend, Data, ML, and Security teams Our technical environment / Tools we use Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Config Connector Reliability & Observability: SLOs, SLIs, monitoring, alerting, incident management Engineering performance: DORA metrics, postmortems, on-call Backend ecosystem: Node.js, TypeScript, Kafka Emerging challenges: AI agents & LLM infrastructure Who you are You have 8+ years of experience in software or infrastructure engineering , including 3+ years hands-on in SRE, DevOps, or backend infrastructure You have 1+ year of experience leading an engineering team You have strong expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and Infrastructure as Code You have firsthand experience with incident management, on-call, observability, and SLOs You understand DORA metrics and know how to improve engineering performance You enjoy coaching senior engineers You can challenge technical decisions and make pragmatic trade-offs You remain calm under pressure and communicate clearly in English Experience with high-traffic platforms, GCP, FinOps, or AI infrastructure is a plus In your first 6 months, you will Take ownership of platform reliability, including SLOs, dashboards, alerting, and incident follow-up Improve delivery performance through DORA metrics and stronger operational practices Deliver the infrastructure to deploy AI agents alongside Staff Engineers and Security Monitor GCP costs and implement agreed optimization initiatives Build a trusted, high-performing team where experienced engineers can thrive The recruitment process Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition Interview with Mikael, our Platform Engineering Director Technical case study and debrief with the Platform Engineering team, including a management assessment Cultural fit assessments And if everything went well, an offer! Our approach to privacy & safety As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts. Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact. title: Senior Field Marketer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline. As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners. - Drive pipeline goals in partnership with Sales by building field programs that create new opportunities and help advance existing ones. Track and report on pipeline contribution and program ROI. - Build out strategies, shape our calendar, and work closely with sales to build out a calendar that touches the evolving sales needs. - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition. - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs. - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 8+ years of related marketing experience. - You’re a leader. You take ownership, bring people together around a clear plan, and keep programs moving from idea through execution. You’re comfortable making decisions, navigating ambiguity, and building trust with partners along the way. - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life. - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics. - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it. - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses - Salesforce, Marketo experience We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $175,000-$200,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>Solutions Architect - Public Sector</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>A trusted advisor to U.S. government customers, helping them understand how GitLab’s DevSecOps platform addresses business and mission outcomes. Owns the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle and provides technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>- Engage government customers, onsite and remotely, with tailored demos, technical presentations and hands-on workshops throughout the pre-sales process.</p> <p>- Manage the technical aspects of the sales cycle, including high quality presentations, custom demos, proofs of concept, technical deep-dive sessions and workshops, RFI and RFP responses, and differentiating GitLab from alternatives.</p> <p>- Be the directly responsible individual (DRI) for technical evaluations and success plans, including POC/POV ownership, tender and audit support and technical input into proposals, capturing success criteria and handoff details for a smooth path to deployment and adoption.</p> <p>- Partner with the sales team to shape and execute account strategies that drive GitLab adoption within government environments.</p> <p>- Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders so they become advocates for GitLab within their organizations.</p> <p>- Run Value Stream Assessments to identify opportunities for customers to improve their software delivery, with support from a Senior SA.</p> <p>- Take part in conferences and trade shows, and contribute to case studies, white papers and media articles for government customers and partners.</p> <p>- Deliver world-class customer service during pre-sales, implementation and post-sales activities.</p> <p>- Channel customer feedback internally to influence roadmap and messaging, and keep building your expertise in GitLab and related technologies.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <p>- Consumption experience: Independently owning a straightforward consumption-led technical motion with the AE in government environments, from usage-led discovery and technical POV through an adoption hypothesis and clear next steps toward production.</p> <p>- Technical experience: Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and containers, and working knowledge of on-premises, self-managed and restricted-network environments alongside cloud, including installation, configuration, upgrades and integration with existing enterprise tooling.</p> <p>- Experience supporting federal customers through technical evaluations, solution design and the path to authorization.</p> <p>- Experience with technical pre-sales, or as a professional in the field of information technology.</p> <p>- Experience with cloud computing platforms and related technologies in regulated or security conscious environments.Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks, such as FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, NIST 800-53 and the Risk Management Framework, DISA STIGs and FIPS 140, and how they shape deployment and tooling decisions.</p> <p>- The ability to connect technical solutions to measurable business or mission outcomes and to advise senior stakeholders on trade-offs and options.</p> <p>- Strong, confident communication and relationship building skills, including leading customer meetings, demos and value-focused conversations.</p> <p>- TS/SCI security clearance is a plus,  but not a requirement.</p> <p>- Location in the Washington, DC metro area.</p> <p>- Openness to learning, seeking feedback and building new skills.</p> <p>- Ability to travel at least 25%.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Public Sector Solutions Architecture team sits within GitLab Sales and works with U.S. federal and other government customers and partners to show how GitLab’s DevSecOps platform supports mission outcomes in regulated, security conscious environments.</p> <p>We work alongside the Public Sector sales team through every stage of the cycle, from first conversation and RFI or RFP responses to deployment and adoption.</p> <p>GitLab sells in a consumption-based model, so our work does not end at the proof of value. We stay close after the technical win to help agencies move from evaluation to production use and growth.</p> <p>We share what we learn, coach each other, and care about measurable mission outcomes.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Career Program Participant (m/w/d) – Exklusive Beta-Phase für Professionals
description: Wir sind Alvra Labs , ein Venture Studio mit Sitz in Basel. Wir entwickeln digitale Produkte und Ventures im Bereich KI und Zukunftstechnologien, die Menschen mehr Zeit, Wahlfreiheit und berufliche Selbstbestimmung ermöglichen. Das Problem & unser neuer Ansatz Der Arbeitsmarkt hat ein massives Matching-Problem: Qualifizierte Professionals schicken CVs an anonyme Portale, während Unternehmen nach genau diesen Talenten suchen – und sie im Rauschen nicht finden. Aus unserem Venture Studio heraus entwickeln wir aktuell ein neues Venture für inverses Headhunting : Ein persönlicher Career Coach arbeitet exklusiv auf deiner Seite, erkennt dein Potenzial jenseits des Lebenslaufs und vertritt dich aktiv im Markt. Für unsere geschlossene Beta-Phase wählen wir gezielt eine handvoll qualifizierter Persönlichkeiten aus, die diesen Ansatz gemeinsam mit uns testen. Was wir gemeinsam einsetzen Potenzial-Assessment & 360°-Sicht: Strukturierte Analyse deiner Stärken – ergänzt durch optionales Feedback ehemaliger Kollegen, um dein Profil über den CV hinaus greifbar zu machen. Inverses Headhunting: Dein Coach sucht aktiv nach passenden Positionen und bewirbt dein Profil gezielt im Markt. Bewerbungs-Support & Warm Intros: Je nach Situation unterstützen wir dich direkt im Bewerbungsprozess oder nutzen unser Netzwerk für persönliche Vorstellungen (Warm Intros) bei relevanten Unternehmen. Beta-Feedback: Du testest den Prozess in der Praxis und gibst uns direktes Feedback zur Weiterentwicklung. Wen wir suchen 3 bis 12 Jahre Berufserfahrung (Mid-Career) sowie ein Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbarer Leistungsausweis. Klarer Anspruch an den nächsten Karriereschritt und Offenheit für einen neuen Recruiting-Ansatz. Rahmenbedingungen Kostenloser Zugang: Ausgewählte Teilnehmer der Beta-Kohorte erhalten kostenlosen Zugang zur Plattform und zur Begleitung durch unsere Coaches. 100 % Remote & Diskretion: Volle Kontrolle darüber, welche Features genutzt werden und wem dein Profil vorgestellt wird. Bewerbung & Auswahlprozess Kurz bewerben und Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil hochladen. Wir prüfen alle eingehenden Profile und wählen passende Teilnehmer für die Kohorte aus. Ausgewählte Beta-User erhalten ihre persönliche Einladung, um ihren Plattform-Login zu erstellen und den 1:1 Intro Call zu buchen . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.</p> <h2><strong>Why you’ll love this role</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.</li> <li><strong>Learning and Growth :</strong> You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture:</strong> You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration:</strong> You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own and Ship Features:</strong> Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.</li> <li><strong>Build for Production:</strong> Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.</li> <li><strong>Test and Review:</strong> Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.</li> <li><strong>Operate What You Build:</strong> Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> <li><strong>Leverage AI:</strong> Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>On Call Support: </strong>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Fundamentals:</strong> Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability:</strong> Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Feature Ownership:</strong> The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Practical Judgment:</strong> Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.</li> <li><strong>Clear Communication:</strong> Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.</li> </ul> logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.</li> <li>Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.</li> </ul> <div
