title: GTM Pricing & Packaging Lead, Commercial Operations
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. AI, UX writing, metrics, or tooling.</li> <li>Mentor technical writers and team members on best practices and prioritization.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>End-to-end expertise in planning, researching, writing, and editing software documentation.</li> <li>UX and content design skills, with a track record of refining interface text, labels, and naming conventions to improve the product user experience.</li> <li>Experience designing and using AI workflows, including evaluating and refining AI-generated output and guiding quality checks for others.</li> <li>Proficiency working in a docs-as-code environment, using the same workflows and tooling as engineering, operations, and product teams.</li> <li>Fluency using the Linux shell and command-line Git, coupled with general familiarity with one or more programming languages.</li> <li>Excellent grammar, minimalist documentation design skills, and effective information architecture.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills, with the ability to triage and prioritize numerous issues and projects across stages and sections.</li> <li>A track record of leading cross-team projects and process improvements, building alignment with stakeholders, and driving adoption.</li> <li>Data-driven decision making, using analytics and feedback to guide content strategy and demonstrate impact.</li> <li>The ability to succeed in a remote, globally distributed environment, including collaborating across countries and time zones, and to model respectful, professional communication.</li> title: Accountmanager in Auction Business - Nouvelle Aquitaine (gn)
description: For this position we source for our sistercompany Troostwijk. About us Troostwijk and it's group TBAuctions are one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support. What your day-to-day work will involve As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business. The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market. You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships. What this means in practice Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market. Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust. Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations. Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers. Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps. Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion. Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools. Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams. What matters in this role We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward. What you should bring Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition. Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results. Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills. Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach. Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence. French as a native language and the ability to work in English. A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business. What we offer Autonomy with professional support You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions. Build something with visible impact The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development. Performance that pays off You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance. Your benefits Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work. Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of the role</strong></h4> <p>As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.</li> <li>Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.</li> <li>Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.</li> <li>Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.</li> <li>Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.</li> <li>Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.</li> <li>Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.</li> <li>Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.</li> <li>Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.</li> <li>Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.</li> <li>Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.</li> <li>Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.</li> <li>Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.</li> <li>Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare You’ll combine people-focused leadership, technical judgment, and business acumen to develop engineers, strengthen our support program, and help customers realize value from GitLab.</p> <p>You’ll also connect the team’s technical contributions to outcomes that matter across the business. By bringing together engineers’ firsthand observations, product trends, and recurring customer pain points, you’ll turn field signal into actionable insights for Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Co-lead, coach, and develop a team of Support Engineers, building a culture of trust, accountability, technical excellence, and revenue protection, growth opportunities, customer adoption, and faster time to value.</li> <li>Use operational data, customer context, and qualitative feedback to evaluate support effectiveness, communicate impact, and guide investment and improvement decisions.</li> <li>Establish a repeatable approach to capturing engineers’ insights and identifying product trends, recurring customer pain points, adoption barriers, and emerging government requirements.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to turn support intelligence into actionable recommendations for product improvements, enablement, and customer engagement.</li> <li>Maintain technical engagement by joining customer calls, reviewing tickets, and helping engineers navigate complex or sensitive issues, while developing the team’s ability to resolve challenges independently.</li> <li>Coordinate responses to escalated and critical customer situations during working hours, providing clear communication and sound judgment.</li> <li>Champion improvements that address recurring problems, reduce customer friction, and strengthen the quality and scalability of our U.S. Government support offering.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated success leading and developing technical support or engineering teams, including coaching, performance management, career development, and leadership through growth and change.</li> <li>A strong technical background supporting complex enterprise software or infrastructure, with the ability to assess technical challenges, recognize the value engineers deliver, and understand the implications for customer outcomes.</li> <li>Experience translating technical accomplishments into business value for executive and sales audiences, using clear storytelling supported by data and customer context.</li> <li>Business acumen to connect support outcomes with revenue protection, customer retention, growth, product adoption, and time to value.</li> <li>The ability to treat engineers’ knowledge and customer interactions as sources of business intelligence, synthesizing individual observations into meaningful trends and actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Experience setting priorities, planning resources, and improving support programs while balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term organizational goals.</li> <li>A people-focused leadership approach that builds trust, encourages candid feedback, recognizes contributions, and creates opportunities for engineers to grow.</li> <li>Experience managing high-severity incidents and sensitive escalations, including effective communication with customers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>The ability to influence across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, building alignment around customer needs and shared business outcomes.</li> <li>Familiarity with U.S. Government customers and the operational, security, and regulatory constraints that shape their environments. We also welcome candidates with relevant experience in other complex or regulated industries.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our U.S. Government Support team formed in 2019 and has grown alongside the adoption of GitLab within government agencies. We help customers troubleshoot complex environments and use GitLab’s DevSecOps platform securely and effectively.</p> <p>Distributed across the United States, we combine synchronous and asynchronous collaboration to support customers and build strong working relationships in a remote-first environment. Our team includes both tenured and newer engineers, bringing diverse technical experience and perspectives.</p> <p>We’re focused on developing our people, scaling our operations, strengthening crisis management for sensitive systems, and deepening our partnerships across GitLab. As a senior leader, you’ll help make the team’s technical expertise and customer knowledge more valuable to the broader organization, while ensuring engineers have the support, direction, and development opportunities they need to succeed.</p> <h4><br><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description: <p>In security risk management we’re looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. </p> <p>To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will not only work within the team but also cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical.</p> <p>The security risk management team’s mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.</p> <h2>What you will do in this role:</h2> <ul> <li>Define Canonical's security risk management  standards and playbooks</li> <li>Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices</li> <li>Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices</li> <li>Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice</li> <li>Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials</li> <li>Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change</li> <li>Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs</li> <li>Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)</li> <li>Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions</li> <li>Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes</li> <li>Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action</li> <li>Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions </li> <li>Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes</li> <li>Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company</li> <li>Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record </li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security</li> <li>Leadership and management ability</li> <li>Excellent business English writing and presentation skills</li> <li>Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management</li> <li>Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks</li> <li>Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk</li> <li>Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. satisfaction across your portfolio.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Partner with customers to translate pre-sales command plans and desired business outcomes into actionable objectives and clear success criteria.</li> <li value="2">Guide customers on how to best use the GitLab platform, including common DevSecOps best practices, Git workflows, CI/CD, and adoption patterns.</li> <li value="3">Own a book of customers and drive adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction through ongoing strategic and technical engagement.</li> <li value="4">Build and maintain Customer onboarding, including education on new GitLab features, releases, and relevant use cases.</li> <li value="7">Program manage account escalations, ensuring root causes are understood, follow-up actions are owned, and stakeholders are informed.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with Services and other internal teams to identify and recommend training, enablement, and maturity opportunities aligned to customer needs.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Practical understanding of Git, common branching strategies, and modern software development lifecycles.</li> <li value="2">Working knowledge of continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices.</li> <li value="3">Experience partnering with customers to define business outcomes and translate them into actionable success plans, key goals, and measures.</li> <li value="4">Background in customer success, post-sales, or professional services roles focused on adoption, retention, and satisfaction.</li> <li value="5">Ability to manage a portfolio of customers, including handling escalations and coordinating across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.</li> <li value="6">Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and analytical thinking.</li> <li value="7">Experience planning and managing projects or initiatives in technical environments, including identifying training and enablement needs.</li> <li value="8">Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in applying transferable skills from related roles or industries, with flexibility to travel as needed according to company policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We are part of GitLab’s Customer Success organization. Our mission is to help customers align the GitLab platform with their business objectives through hands-on technical enablement, driving adoption, utilization, and DevSecOps maturity while building strong, consultative relationships. As Customer Success Architects, we act as trusted advisors and key liaisons between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem, collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Professional Services to address questions, guide roadmaps, and navigate escalations. This team helps turn customer priorities into real adoption and measurable outcomes by guiding complex implementations, shaping new service patterns, and bringing emerging GitLab capabilities into production environments.</p> <p>You'll own the Global Technical Architecture practice across both presales and delivery, managing a team of AMER Technical Architects who work on complex customer needs, early-stage offerings, and strategic engagements. This role is well suited for someone who can coach senior technical talent, bring structure to ambiguity, and keep the team focused on customer outcomes instead of task completion.</p> <p>In your first year, you'll focus on stabilizing and growing the team, tightening the link between presales scoping and delivery, and turning field work into repeatable offerings. You'll work alongside architects in areas including AI, security, and broader platform architecture, while helping the team turn what they learn in the field into repeatable methods that can scale across Professional Services.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Running technical discovery, scoping, and delivery for complex Professional Services engagements in AMER</li> <li>Turning early customer work on new GitLab capabilities into repeatable delivery kits, standards, and service patterns</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hire, manage, and develop a growing AMER Technical Architecture team, including Intermediate, Senior, and Staff Technical Architects working across platform, AI, and security-related customer engagements.</li> <li>Lead the global Technical Architecture practice, aligning architects in AMER, EMEA, and APJ on shared standards for scoping, statement of work review, service offerings and delivery leadership.</li> utilization, delivery quality, and forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Coach architects to grow from hands-on implementers into technical leaders and credible advisors on most of their engagements, with a focus on customer outcomes, strong technical judgment, and consultative communication.</li> <li>Partner on complex presales motions with Engagement Managers on estimation, solution framing, technical GitLab capabilities, helping shape how emerging offerings are tested, delivered, and improved in real customer environments to shorten time to production and increase successful adoption.</li> <li>Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable templates, architecture guidance, migration patterns, and implementation standards that increase reuse and improve delivery consistency across the broader Professional Services organization.</li> <li>Represent the Technical Architecture practice in AMER Professional Services management discussions and partner with adjacent functions to improve coordination, service evolution, and delivery consistency.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience managing senior technical professionals in a services, consulting, or Professional Services environment, with a strong track record of coaching, performance management, and career development.</li> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab, software development, site reliability and infrastructure engineering, security, cloud architecture, and agile delivery, with enough depth to guide technical direction and build credibility with highly experienced architects.</li> <li>Experience running consultative engagements by linking technical work to business goals and keeping teams focused on customer value and realized outcomes.</li> <li>Experience with technically complex presales work, including discovery, scoping, estimation, solution definition, and risk assessment.</li> <li>Experience running a billable team against utilization targets, with a clear grasp of how utilization, margin, and forecast accuracy drive Professional Services revenue.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments where offerings, priorities, and organizational needs continue to evolve.</li> <li>Experience building or improving repeatable delivery methods such as playbooks, standards, service kits, architecture patterns, or implementation guidance.</li> <li>A servant-leadership style built on empathy and continuous improvement: you remove blockers for your team, act on what retrospectives surface, and build processes that make it easy to do the right thing.</li> <li>Experience leading customer conversations at every level, from platform engineers to the CTO, giving clear feedback, and aligning cross-functional stakeholders around delivery direction.</li> <li>Familiarity with GitLab-relevant domains such as AI-powered developer workflows, security, DevSecOps, or enterprise platform adoption is helpful, along with experience ramping up quickly in adjacent areas where needed.</li> <li>Experience using AI to scale how your team scopes, documents, and delivers work.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25%.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services team helps customers adopt GitLab in ways that create lasting value. Within that organization, the Technical Architecture team handles some of the most complex and ambiguous work. This includes shaping early delivery approaches for new capabilities, contributing to high-impact customer engagements, and creating the patterns that help the wider organization scale successful services.</p> <p>You'll manage a growing AMER team of Technical Architects, lead the global Technical Architecture practice, and work closely with Engagement Management, Professional Services Operations, Customer Experience Engineering, and other Professional Services colleagues. title: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - German (Switzerland) - Remote
description: About The Opportunity We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches. Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity What You’ll Deliver Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents. Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling. Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary). Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity. Qualifications Experience: 1+ years of industry experience in software or prompt engineering. This is not a traditional external-facing product role—it is an internal platform product leadership position. You will own the roadmap for our enterprise systems, act as the strategic voice of the business within engineering, and bring senior product craft to a team of Analysts and engineers who build and operate GitLab's revenue infrastructure. </p> <p>This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who has deep Quote-to-Cash or Finance domain knowledge, thrives at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, and is energized by mentoring high-performing teams through complex, multi-program environments.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do  </strong></h3> <p><strong>Internal Product Roadmap Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for QTC and Finance Systems, covering Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, NetSuite, and the CDot metering platform.</li> <li>Translate business strategy from Finance, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Sales into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics.</li> <li>Balance competing program demands—stabilization, net-new capability delivery, and technical debt reduction—with transparent trade-off frameworks.</li> <li>Drive quarterly and annual planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and Business Systems Analysts to align capacity with roadmap commitments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements Translation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary internal product voice for all QTC and Finance Systems initiatives, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Legal.</li> <li>Lead discovery, requirements workshops, and business process design sessions to translate complex financial and commercial requirements into actionable system specifications.</li> <li>Own the decision layer between "what the business needs" and "what engineering builds," resolving ambiguity with structured frameworks and documented decisions.</li> <li>Navigate cross-functional stakeholder dynamics including SOX compliance, audit controls, and revenue recognition governance (ASC 606/IFRS 15).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Mentorship & Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a product craft mentor and senior thought partner for the BSA team, actively upskilling analysts in product thinking, requirements structuring, acceptance criteria definition, and roadmap communication.</li> <li>Model and instill product management best practices—user story writing, prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE, MoSCoW), sprint review discipline, and outcome tracking—across the team.</li> <li>Partner with leadership to evolve the operating model of the team from project-execution-focused to product-thinking-led, raising the bar for how ETA delivers business value.</li> <li>Provide structured feedback and growth coaching to BSAs on career development, helping analysts grow toward senior and lead levels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Program Strategy & Delivery Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead product strategy for major multi-quarter programs (e.g., consumption-based billing iterations, CLM/Order Forms, Zuora Product Catalog refactors, ERP optimization) from discovery through go-live.</li> <li>Define and maintain program-level dependency maps across concurrent workstreams, surfacing risks early and driving cross-team resolution.</li> <li>Own UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with BSAs, ensuring system changes meet business requirements before production release.</li> <li>Support post-launch stabilization and continuous improvement cycles, prioritizing defect resolution and incremental enhancements based on business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Architecture Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers to evaluate build-vs-buy-vs-configure decisions for new capabilities.</li> <li>Bring informed opinions on QTC platform architecture trade-offs (e.g., billing model design, middleware integration patterns, revenue recognition rule configuration) based on deep domain knowledge.</li> <li>Stay current on platform roadmaps for Salesforce, Zuora, and NetSuite, identifying opportunities to leverage native capabilities before custom builds.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in an internal platform PM, enterprise applications PM, or systems product leadership role.</li> <li>Deep domain expertise in Quote-to-Cash systems: Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, and NetSuite ERP are the core stack—hands-on configuration or implementation experience strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong command of revenue lifecycle processes: opportunity-to-quote, order management, billing and collections, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and financial close.</li> <li>Experience operating in a SOX-controlled environment with an understanding of audit trails, approval workflows, and change management requirements for financial systems.</li> <li>Track record of successfully running complex, multi-program delivery environments with competing priorities and shared engineering resources.</li> <li>Sufficient technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering on API design, data model decisions, and integration trade-offs—without needing to write code.</li> <li>Experience with consumption-based or usage-based billing models</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>You'll be joining the Revenue Lifecycle & Finance Systems team within GitLab's Enterprise Technology Architecture organization. Our team is responsible for the systems and processes that power GitLab's entire revenue lifecycle—from configure-price-quote through contract execution, billing, revenue recognition, and financial close. </p> <p>We are in an exciting and demanding phase: transitioning GitLab's go-to-market from a pure subscription model toward consumption-based offerings while simultaneously modernizing our core platforms. our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Delivering GitLab installations and upgrades using tools like Terraform or Ansible, from simple deployments to highly available architectures</li> <li value="2">Leading migrations from existing systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, including planning, execution, and knowledge transfer</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Deliver Professional Services engagements such as installation, migration, training, and advisory services to help customers achieve successful outcomes with GitLab, including completing projects on scope and on schedule.</li> <li value="2">Plan and execute GitLab deployments across a range of architectures, from single-node Omnibus installations to large reference architectures using infrastructure as code and configuration as code practices.</li> <li value="3">Oversee and perform migrations from multiple source systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, helping customers reduce risk, maintain momentum during change, and complete cutovers with minimal disruption.</li> <li value="4">Provide technical guidance across the GitLab feature stack, helping customers adopt best practices that fit their goals, constraints, and operating environment.</li> <li value="5">Partner closely with project managers and engagement managers by providing feedback and updates that improve delivery consistency, keep work on schedule, and reduce delivery issues across engagements.</li> <li value="6">Manage and deliver multiple customer projects at once, balancing customer outcomes with awareness of billable time and delivery priorities to meet utilization and delivery goals.</li> <li value="7">Mentor and assist other Professional Services Engineers by communicating expertise in specific technical areas and contributing to stronger, more repeatable delivery patterns.</li> <li value="8">Work closely with GitLab's product and engineering teams to remove blockers for customers and help improve GitLab features and delivery processes based on field insights, leading to faster issue resolution and more consistent delivery.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll <strong><strong class="textBold">bring</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.</li> <li value="2">Experience with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.</li> <li><strong><strong their environments and engagements.</li> <li value="5">Ability to lead technical delivery end-to-end, including discovery, planning, documentation, and knowledge transfer.</li> </ul> <h2>About the While the Creative Operations Manager focuses on the long-term pipeline, you will manage the live, day-to-day workflow and reactive resourcing shifts. </p> <p>You’ll handle brief intake, scheduling, capacity planning, and urgent "fire-drill" requests, ensuring that daily traffic across our resource charts reflects the real-time capacity and capabilities of our design and writing team.</p> <p>You’ll serve as an on-the-ground process champion and gatekeeper for the designer and writers time, ensuring they are protected from scope creep and unrealistic deadlines while maintaining smooth, collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Day-to-Day Traffic & Resource Planning: </strong>Manage the live studio pipeline, project queues, and daily resource allocation across designers, copywriters, and motion graphic designer.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Reactive Workflow & Capacity Management: </strong>Handle urgent "fire-drill" requests, brief delays, and scope adjustments in real time, shifting schedules and reallocating resources to prevent bottlenecks and balance workloads.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Gatekeeping & Process Championing: </strong>Act as the "gatekeeper of the possible" during briefing sessions and creative reviews. £77,100 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Full-Loop Interviews (1 x Role Specific + 1 x Behavioural)</li> </ul> <p>📆 <strong>Please Note</strong>: We pause hiring from 14th Dec 2026 - title: Android Developer
description: At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible. Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role. The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform. Your role As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps. What you will be doing: Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience. Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early. Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable. Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues. Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Most important benefits Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii). Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow. You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment. You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications. You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines. You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London / UK Remote | 💰£142,000 - £170,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Financial Control team ⭐</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced finance operations leader for a 12-month fixed-term contract to lead our Global Financial Operations and Control team. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.</p> <p>Your mandate is  to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program.  You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.</li> <li>Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.</li> <li>Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.  </li> <li>Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.</li> <li>Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.</li> <li>Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.</li> <li>Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies  and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.</li> <li>Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.</li> <li>Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.</li> <li>Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.</li> <li>Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Scope Clarification</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Included:</strong> Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.</li> <li><strong>Excluded:</strong> Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred). </li> <li>You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.</li> <li>You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.</li> <li>You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.</li> <li>Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.</li> <li>You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.</li> <li>You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS) </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £142,000 - £170,000.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 5 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Initial Call with the Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager Interview</li> <li>Role Specific Interview</li> <li>Behavioural Interview</li> <li>Final Interview with the Team </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.</p> <p> #LI-TP1 #LI-REMOTE<strong><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
description: <p>We are hiring <strong>2026 and 2027 Graduate Software Engineers</strong> into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.</p> <p>If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here.</p> <p>Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday.</p> <p>We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit.</p> <p>If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a Globally remote role.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months</li> <li>Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps</li> <li>Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users</li> <li>Working towards mastery of key programming languages and Linux system knowledge</li> <li>Engaging with users and the open source community through code reviews and issue trackers</li> <li>Responding to customer issues as a priority, develop an understanding of enterprise requirements</li> <li>Developing skills and awareness of security in software design and implementation</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses</li> <li>Confidence to get started and deliver high quality code in one of Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript or Java</li> <li>Experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Result-oriented and organized, with the drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Personal responsibility and accountability</li> <li>Thoughtfulness, self-awareness and the ability to reflect and develop</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Upstream open source contributions</li> <li>Packaging and Linux distribution contributions - Debian, Fedora, Arch, Nix or another</li> <li>Leadership and organization skills</li> <li>Presentation and writing skills</li> <li>Business and commercial interests</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

and writing high-quality Web technologies</li> <li>Experience with and passion for Typescript, React, Svelte or Flutter</li> <li>An eye for accessibility and performance</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation </li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills </li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events for up to two weeks each</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Attention to detail concerning user-centric UI development</li> <li>REST API design, development and governance</li> <li>Performance engineering and security experience</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer colleagues</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Customer Success Architect, Australia
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
